צד.en: The Second Gate. Introduction. On the explication of the aspects of reflection upon the created things, and the bounty of God's beneficence upon them.

צד.en: and since reflection upon the manifest wisdom in the created things of the Creator (exalted be He) is the nearest of paths to verifying-the-reality of finding Him, and the most well-trodden of roads to the knowledge of His true reality,

צד.en: it was incumbent upon us to follow this with it — so that we might bring each gate together with what is fitting to it among the gates, and follow each concept with what befits it among the concepts by which there is laid upon us obedience to the Creator (exalted be He), for which He created us, as the Book says: "And God has so made it that men should fear before Him" (Ecclesiastes 3:14).

צז.ja: פלמא כאן ד'לך כד'לך לזם אהל אלמערפה ואלעלם תנביה מן ג'הל נעם אללה לתמייזהא, ואלארשאד ללנאס אלי מערפהֵ פצ'להא בטריק עקולהם,
צז.en: Since this is so, it is incumbent on the people of knowledge and understanding to awaken whoever is ignorant of God's blessings into discerning them, and to guide people to the knowledge of His bounty within them by the way of their intellects.

צז.ja: פכם נעמה חרם צאחבהא לד'תהא ונגץ סרורה בהא עדם תמייזה ענהא וג'הלה בפצ'להא,
צז.en: For how many a blessing is its possessor deprived of its sweetness, and his joy in it spoiled, by his lack of discernment and his ignorance of its bounty!

pairs.en: how many a blessing
is its possessor deprived of its sweetness
and his joy in it spoiled
by his lack of discernment
and his ignorance of its bounty

צז.ja: פאד'א אשער אהל אלנעם בוג'וה אלפצ'ל פיהא וכשף להם עמא כ'פי ענהם מנהא עט'ם חמדהם ושכרהם ללמנעם בהא עליהם,
צז.en: When the people of blessings are made to perceive the aspects of bounty in them, and there is unveiled to them what was hidden from them of these, great will be their praise and thanksgiving to the One who has bestowed them.

pairs.en: When the people of blessings are made to perceive
the aspects of bounty in them

pairs.ja: וכשף להם עמא כ'פי ענהם מנהא

צז.ja: פיחצל להם בד'לך אלאלתד'אד' בהא פי אלדניא וג'זיל אלת'ואב פי אלאכ'רה, כקול אלחכים פי מעני אלתנביה דברי חכמים כדרבנות וכמשמרות נטועים בעלי אסופות נתנו מרעה אחד,
צז.en: There will come to them, by this, both the savoring of them in this world and abundant reward in the next, as the Wise One said in the matter of awakening: "The words of the wise are like goads, and as nails firmly fixed — the masters of collections; they were given by one Shepherd" (Ecclesiastes 12:11).

צז.ja: מת'ל כלאם אלחכמא באלמנאכ'ס פי מעני אלתנביה, ומת'להא באלמסאמיר אלמת'בותה ד'ואת אלקבץ' ואלג'מע ואלתאליף לת'באת מעאניהא פי אלקלוב, ואנתט'אם וג'וה אלחכמה בהא פי אלנפוס,
צז.en: He compares the speech of the wise, by way of awakening, to ox-goads; and likens it to firmly-fixed nails — for the gathering and binding-together and composing that they accomplish, to fix their meanings in the hearts, and the ordering of the aspects of wisdom by their means within the souls.

pairs.ja: ואנתט'אם וג'וה אלחכמה בהא פי אלנפוס
pairs.en: and the ordering of the aspects of wisdom by their means within the souls

צז.ja: וקד פסר פי בעלי אסופות אצחאב אלתאליף, באצ'מאר דברי אלד'י פי אול אלפסוק, ואלגרץ' וכמשמרות נטועים דברי בעלי אסופות,
צז.en: And *baʿalei asuphot* was explicated as "masters of compilation," supplying the *divrei* from the start of the verse — so that the meaning reads: *and as nails firmly fixed are the words of the masters of compilation* —

masters of compilation

צז.ja: לאן אלכתב אלמולפה פי צנוף אלחכמה ת'אבתה באקיה לא ינקטע נפעהא, ולד'לך מת'להא באלמסאמיר אלמת'בותה.
צז.en: because books composed in the various kinds of wisdom are stable and enduring; their benefit is never severed. That is why he likens them to nails firmly fixed.

צז.ja: פינבגי אלאן אן נביין מן אמר אלאעתבאר
צז.en: So it is now fitting that we explain, of the matter of reflection,

pairs.en: So it is now fitting
that we explain
of the matter of reflection
concerning six matters

צח.en: The first of them is on the definition of reflection and its true nature.

pairs.en: The first of them
is on the definition of reflection
and its true nature

צח.ja: ואלת'אני הל ילזמנא אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין אם לא.
צח.en: The second: whether reflection upon the created things is incumbent upon us or not.

whether reflection upon the created things is incumbent upon us
upon the created things
or not

צח.en: The third: in what way is reflection upon the created things to be done.

pairs.en: The third

upon the created things

צח.ja: ואלראבע כם צנוף אלחכמה פי אלמכ'לוקין אלתי ימכננא אלאעתבאר בהא.
צח.en: The fourth: how many kinds of wisdom there are in the created things by which it is possible for us to reflect.

pairs.en: The fourth
how many kinds of wisdom there are
in the created things
by which it is possible for us to reflect

צח.ja: ואלכ'אמס אי אלצנוף אקרב מנא ואוג'ב עלינא אלאעתבאר בה מן סאירהא.
צח.en: The fifth: which of the kinds is nearest to us and most obligatory upon us to reflect upon, more than the rest of them.

pairs.en: The fifth
which of the kinds is nearest to us
and most obligatory upon us to reflect upon
more than the rest of them

צח.en: The sixth: on the things that spoil reflection and what follows from them.

pairs.en: The sixth

צח.ja: קאל, ואמא מאהיהֵ אלאעתבאר, פהו אלתפהם לאת'אר חכמהֵ אללה ג'ל ועז פי אלמכ'לוקין, ותקדירהא פי אלנפס חסב קוהֵ תמייז אלמעתבר.
צח.en: He said: As for the definition of reflection — it is the comprehension of the traces of God's wisdom (mighty and exalted) in the created things, and the registering of these in the soul according to the strength of the reflecting man's discernment.

pairs.en: He said
As for the definition of reflection
it is the comprehension
of the traces of God's wisdom (mighty and exalted)
in the created things

צח.ja: וד'לך אן אלחכמה ואן אכ'תלפת את'ארהא פי אלמכ'לוקין פהי ואחדה פי אסהא ואצלהא,
צח.en: For wisdom — though its traces vary in the created things — is one in its root and its source.

pairs.en: For wisdom
though its traces vary
in the created things
is one
in its root and its source

צח.ja: כאלשמס אלתי הי ואחדה פי ד'אתהא ותכ'תלף אלואן שעאעהא פי אלשמסאת אלתי תצנע מן אלזג'אג' אלאביץ' ואלאכ'צ'ר ואלאסוד ואלאחמר, פיכ'תלף צ'והא עלי חסב אכ'תלאף אלואן אלזג'אג'.
צח.en: It is like the sun, which is one in itself, but the colors of its ray differ in the panes of glass that are made of white glass, of green, of black, of red — so that its light differs according to the differences in the colors of the glass.

pairs.en: It is like the sun

so that its light differs

צח.ja: וכאלמא אלד'י יסקי בה אלריאץ' פכת'רג' אלנואויר אלמכ'תלפהֵ אלאלואן פיתלוון פיהא בחסב ד'לך.
צח.en: And like the water by which the gardens are watered: it brings forth the flowers, differing in color, so that the water itself takes on color according to them.

pairs.en: And like the water
by which the gardens are watered
it brings forth the flowers
differing in color
so that the water itself takes on color according to them

צח.ja: פאפהם ען מכ'לוקאת אלבארי ג'ל ועז דקיקהא וג'לילהא, ותרדד פימא כ'פי ענך מנהא תג'דהא עלי מא וצפת אן שא אללה.
צח.en: So understand, regarding the created things of the Maker (mighty and exalted) — both the small among them and the great — and consider attentively what is hidden from you of them, and you will find them as I have described, God willing.

pairs.en: So understand
regarding the created things of the Maker (mighty and exalted)
both the small among them and the great
and consider attentively what is hidden from you of them
and you will find them as I have described
God willing

צח.ja: ומן אג'ל אכ'תלאפהא פי אלמכ'לוקין לזמנא אלתפהם להא ואלתפכר פיהא חתי יחצל מענאהא פי נפוסנא ויסתקר פי אוהאמנא.
צח.en: It is on account of the difference of these traces in the created things that the comprehension and reflection upon them have been laid upon us — until their concept becomes established within our souls and settles in our imaginations.

pairs.en: It is on account of the difference of these traces
in the created things
that the comprehension and reflection upon them have been laid upon us
and reflection

צח.ja: ולו כאנת את'ארהא ואחדה פי ג'מיע אלמכ'לוקין לם ישתבה עלי אחד אמרהא, ואסתוי אלעאקל ואלג'אהל פי אלתמייז ענהא, ואלעלה
צח.en: For if the traces of wisdom were uniform throughout all created things, no one would be in doubt regarding their matter, and the man of intellect and the ignorant would be equal in discerning them; and the cause

צט.ja: פי ד'לך- ואללה אעלם ואחכם- אלתי מן אג'להא לם יכן ג'מיע אלמכ'לוקין עלי מת'אל ואחד ושכל ואחד,
צט.en: The cause for this — and God knows best and is wisest — on account of which not all created things were on a single pattern and a single shape,

pairs.en: The cause for this
and God knows best and is wisest
on account of which
not all created things were
on a single pattern
and a single shape

צט.ja: לאן אלשי אלד'י יפעל פעלא ואחדא דאימא ידל עלי אן פעלה ליס באכ'תיארה,
צט.en: is that the thing that performs one action only, perpetually, indicates that its action is not by its choice —

pairs.en: is that the thing that
performs one action only
perpetually
indicates that
its action is not by its choice

צט.ja: ואנמא יפעל בטבעה אלד'י טבע עליה פקט, ולה קאסר יקסרה עלי ד'לך אלפעל וליס ימכנה אלתגייר ענה,
צט.en: but rather it acts only by the nature with which it has been impressed, and there is a compeller compelling it to that action, with no possibility of changing it:

pairs.en: but rather it acts
only by the nature with which it has been impressed
and there is a compeller compelling it
to that action
with no possibility of changing it

צט.ja: כאלנאר אלתי להא אלאחראק פקט, וכאלמא אלד'י יברד בטבעה פקט,
צט.en: like fire, whose action is only to burn; and like water, which cools only by its nature.

pairs.en: like fire
whose action is only to burn
and like water
which cools only by its nature

צט.ja: ואלד'י יפעל באכ'תיארה תט'הר ענה אפעאל מכ'תלפה.
צט.en: But that which acts by its choice — diverse actions become manifest from it.

pairs.en: But that which acts by its choice
become manifest from it
diverse actions

צט.ja: פלמא כאן אלכ'אלק תעאלי מכ'תארא לפעלה גיר מקהור ולא מצ'טר ולא מטבוע,
צט.en: Since the Creator (exalted be He) is *choosing* in His action — not compelled, not constrained, not impressed-with-nature —

pairs.en: Since the Creator (exalted be He)
is *choosing* in His action
not compelled
not constrained
not impressed-with-nature

צט.ja: פעל אלאשיא אלמכ'תלפה חסב מא אוג'בת חכמתה, לתדל באכ'תלאפהא עלי וחדאניתה, ועלי אנה מכ'תאר לפעלה,
צט.en: He made the various things according to what His wisdom made obligatory, so that, by their variations, they might indicate His unity, and that He is choosing in His action —

pairs.en: He made the various things
according to what His wisdom made obligatory
so that, by their variations, they might indicate
His unity
and that He is choosing in His action

צט.ja: כמא קאל אלולי ע"ס כל אשר חפץ ה' עשה בשמים ובארץ בימים וכל תהומות.
צט.en: as the Friend (peace be upon him) said: "Whatever the Lord pleased, He did, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the deeps" (Psalms 135:6).

pairs.en: as the Friend (peace be upon him) said

צט.ja: פוג'ב מן אג'ל ד'לך אכ'תלאף את'אר אלחכמה פי אלמכ'לוקין,
צט.en: So the diversity of the traces of wisdom in the created things became necessary on this account.

pairs.en: became necessary
on this account
the diversity of the traces of wisdom
in the created things

צט.ja: וחכמתה תעאלי אעלי מן אן נקף עליהא,
צט.en: And His wisdom (exalted be He) is higher than that we should comprehend it —

pairs.en: And His wisdom (exalted be He)
is higher than
that we should comprehend it

צט.ja: ואנמא ד'כרנא וג'הא מן ג'מלהֵ וג'וה כת'ירה לם נקף עליהא,
צט.en: we have mentioned only one aspect from among many aspects we have not grasped,

pairs.en: we have mentioned only one aspect
from among many aspects
we have not grasped

צט.ja: ולה ג'ל ועז אלחכמה אלבאלגה לא רב סואה.
צט.en: for to Him (mighty and exalted) belongs the perfect wisdom; there is no Lord besides Him.

pairs.en: for to Him (mighty and exalted) belongs
the perfect wisdom
there is no Lord besides Him

צט.ja: קאל, ואמא הל ילזמנא אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין אם לא.
צט.en: He said: As for whether we are obligated to reflect upon the created things or not —

pairs.en: He said
As for whether we are obligated

or not

צט.ja: פנקול אן אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין ואלאסתדלאל בהם עלי חכמהֵ אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז לאזם עלינא מן אלמעקול ואלמכתוב ואלמנקול.
צט.en: I say that reflection upon the created things, and inference by them concerning the wisdom of the Creator (mighty and exalted), is laid upon us by the rational, the scriptural, and the transmitted.

pairs.en: I say that

צט.ja: אמא מן אלמעקול, פאן אלעקל ישהד אן פצ'ל אלנאטק עלי גיר אלנאטק אנמא הו בפצ'ל תמייזה ופהמה וקבולה אלעלם,
צט.en: As for from the rational: the intellect testifies that the superiority of the rational being over the non-rational is only by the merit of its discernment, its understanding, and its receiving of knowledge,

pairs.en: As for from the rational

צט.ja: לאסראר אלחכמה אלמת'בתה פי ג'מיע אלעאלם,
צט.en: of the secrets of wisdom established throughout the whole world,

pairs.en: of the secrets of wisdom

ק.ja: כקול אלכתאב מלפנו מבהמות ארץ ומעוף השמים יחכמנו,
ק.en: As for the rational: the intellect bears witness that the bounty of the rational over the non-rational is only by the bounty of its discernment and its receptivity to the secrets of wisdom — as the Book says: "Who teaches us by means of the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens" (Job 35:11).

ק.ja: פאד'א אסתעמל אלאנסאן פכרה ופהמה פי אסראר אלחכמה ואעתבאר את'ארהא כאן פצ'לה עלי אלבהימה בחסב ד'לך,
ק.en: When a man employs his thought and his understanding in the secrets of wisdom and in reflection upon its traces, his bounty over the brute beast is according to that.

his bounty over the brute beast

ק.ja: ואן גפל ענהא כאן מת'ל אלבהימה, בל אנקץ מנהא, נט'יר קול אלכתאב ידע שור קונהו וחמור אבוס בעליו ישראל לא ידע עמי לא התבונן.
ק.en: But if he is heedless of them, he is like the brute beast — indeed, lower than it — as the Book says: "The ox knows its owner, and the ass its master's crib; Israel does not know, My people does not consider" (Isaiah 1:3).

And the harp and the lyre, the tambourine and the flute

but they do not look at the work of the Lord
and they do not see the doing of His hands

ק.ja: וקאלוא מנין שחייב אדם לחשב בתקופות ומזלות שנאמר ושמרתם ועשיתם כי היא חכמתכם ובינתכם לעיני העמים, איזו היא חכמה ובינה שהיא לעיני העמים, הוי אומר זה חשוב תקופות ומזלות.
ק.en: And they said: "Whence that a man is obligated to compute the cycles and the constellations? As it is said: And you shall observe and you shall do, for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples (Deuteronomy 4:6) — what wisdom and understanding is there in the eyes of the peoples? — say: the computation of cycles and constellations" (b. Shabbat 75a).

ק.en: And they said: "Compute the loss of a commandment against its reward, and the reward of a transgression against its loss" (m. Avot 2:1).

ק.ja: וקאלוא אלמלא נתנה תורה לישראל למדנו צניעות מחתול, עריות מיונה, דרך ארץ מתרנגול, גזל מנמלה.
ק.en: And they said: "Had the Torah not been given to Israel, we should have learned chastity from the cat, aversion to forbidden unions from the dove, propriety from the rooster, and not to rob from the ant" (b. Eruvin 100b).

ק.ja: פקד צח וג'וב אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין ואלאסתדלאל באת'אר אלחכמה, פאפהם.
ק.en: Thus the obligation of reflecting upon created things, and of drawing inference from the traces of wisdom, has been established — so understand.

קא.ja: קאל, ואמא כיף וג'ה אלאעתבאר באלמכ'לוקין.

קא.ja: פנקול אן אלאעתבאר באלכ'לוקין הו אלנט'ר פי ארכאן אלעאלם, ופי פרועה אלמולפה מנהא, ופי וצ'ע אג'זא כל מרכב ווג'ה אלמנפעה פיה,
קא.en: I say that reflection upon the created things is consideration of the pillars of the world, and of its branches composed of these, and of the disposition of the parts of every composite and the aspect of its utility,

קא.ja: ואת'אר אלחכמה פי כ'לקתה והיאתה ושכלה ומצלחתה ועלתה אלתמאמיה אלתי כ'לק מן אג'להא,
קא.en: and of the traces of wisdom in its creation and its form and its shape and its welfare, and of the final cause for which it was created —

and its form

and its welfare
and of the final cause

קא.ja: ואלתמייז ען רוחאניהֵ הד'א אלעאלם וג'סמאניתה, ועללה ומעלולאתה, ונאטקה וצאמתה ומתחרכה וסאכנה וג'אמדה ונבאתה ואעלאה ואספלה,
קא.en: and the discrimination between this world's spiritual aspect and its corporeal aspect, between its causes and its effects, its rational and its mute, its moving and its stationary, its solid and its growing, its higher and its lower.

קא.en: And [the recognition] that the Creator (exalted be He) composed the world by a firmly-knit composition, and arranged it by a tightly-binding arrangement, and parsed it by a clear parsing, and made it a pointer to Himself and an evidence for Himself —

קא.en: just as the craftsmanship indicates the craftsman, and the house the builder who built it.

קא.ja: וינבגי אן תעלם אן ג'מלהֵ אלעאלם מולפה מן ג'סמאניאת ורוחאניאת קד מזג'ת וכ'לטת, וצאר בעצ'הא ממסכא לבעצ'הא, כאלנפס ואלג'סד פי אלחיואן.
קא.en: You ought to know that the whole of the world is composed of corporeal entities and spiritual entities — they have been blended and mixed, and the one has come to be a vessel for the other, like the soul and the body in the living being.

קא.ja: ואת'אר אלחכמה פי ג'מיע ד'לך עלי ת'לאת'ה צ'רוב.
קא.en: The traces of wisdom in all of this are of three kinds.

קא.ja: אחדהא את'אר בינה ואצ'חה לא תכ'פי עלי אלג'אהל פצ'לא עלי אלעאקל,

קא.en: such as the motion of the sun's sphere above the earth by day, to illumine the inhabited region, so that the created things derive benefit from it,

קא.ja: כמא קאל אלולי תזרח השמש יאספון ואל מעונותם ירבצון יצא אדם לפעלו ולעבדתו עדי ערב מה רבו מעשיך ה' כלם בחכמה עשית.
קא.en: as the holy one said: "The sun rises, they gather and lie down in their dens; man goes out to his work and to his labor until evening. How manifold are Your works, O Lord! In wisdom You have made them all."

קב.en: Our early ones (peace be upon them) said: "And God saw all that He had made, and behold it was very good" — He means by this: behold, death is good.

קב.en: And the Wise One said: "I praised the dead who are already dead, more than the living who are still living."

קב.ja: ואלצ'רב אלת'אלת' מן את'אר אלחכמה צ'אהרה פי ג'הה וכ'פיה פי ג'הה אכ'רי, פלא ימייז ענהא אלקליל אלפהם אלא בעד אלתת'בת פיהא ואלתקצי עליהא,

קב.en: such as the variation of the year in its conditions through its four seasons, and the like of that.

קב.en: The skillful, discerning man extracts from the world the knowledge of its spiritual realities and its subtleties, and makes them a ladder to the inference of the Creator of all (may He be exalted),

קב.en: so he binds himself to His obedience and His worship according to the measure of His majesty and His greatness in his heart,

pairs.en: so he binds himself
to His obedience and His worship
according to the measure of His majesty and His greatness
in his heart

קב.ja: ובקדר תמייזה לאת'אר ענאיתה ולטפה בג'מלהֵ מכ'לוקאתה, ותפצ'ילה איאה בג'זיל אלנעם, ותשריפה עליהא מן גיר עמל תקדם לה ולא פצ'ילה סבקת מנה אסתוג'ב בהא ג'מיל צנע אללה תעאלי.
קב.en: and in proportion to his discernment of the traces of His providence and His gentleness toward the totality of His creatures, and His favoring of him with abundant blessings, and His exalting of him above them — without any deed preceding from him, nor any merit prior from him, by which he would have deserved the goodly handiwork of God (may He be exalted).

קב.en: and he strives in his work for his afterlife and for that to which he will come after his death,

pairs.en: and he strives in his work

קב.ja: ויעתקד אלדניא ומתאעהא בלאגא וזאדא למעאדה ואכ'רתה, פהו יאכ'ד' מנהא מא יצח בה ענד רחילה ענהא פקט.
קב.en: and he regards this world and its goods as a provision and a viaticum for his return and his afterlife, so he takes from it only what will serve him well at his departure from it.

קב.ja: ואלג'אהל באלדניא ובאת'אר אלחכמה פיהא יג'עלהא דאר כ'לודה ומאואה, פיסעי להא ג'הדה, ויצרף אליהא ג'מיע ענאיתה וכדה, ט'נא אנה יג'רי פי מצלחהֵ נפסה, ולא ישער אן כדה ופצ'ל ג'מעה פיהא צאיר אלי
קב.en: But the ignorant man, ignorant of this world and of the traces of wisdom within it, makes it the abode of his eternity and his dwelling-place, so he labors for it to the utmost of his power, and he directs to it all his concern and his toil, supposing that he is acting for the welfare of his own self, yet he does not perceive that his toil and the surplus of what he amasses in it is destined to —

קג.en: These two resemble, in that respect, two brothers who inherited from their father a piece of land that required tending and cultivation, so they divided it into two halves, and they had nothing else besides it.

קג.en: One of them was sensible and prudent, and the other was the opposite of that.

קג.ja: פאלעאקל ראי אן שגלה בארצ'ה פקט יקטעה ען אלתחייל פי מעאשה ואסתג'לאב רזקה, פאסתאג'ר פי עמל ארץ' גירה ליעיש מן אג'רהֵ עמלה יומא ביום,
קג.en: The sensible one saw that occupying himself with his land alone would cut him off from contriving for his livelihood and procuring his sustenance, so he hired himself out to work another's land, in order to live from the wage of his labor day by day.

קג.ja: פכאן אד'א אנטלק מן עמלה לגירה פי עשי יומה אגתנם פסחהֵ סאעה מנה ועמל פי ארצ'ה בג'ד ונשאט, פאד'א אסתפצ'ל מן אג'רהֵ איאם קות יום או אכת'ר מן ד'לך תרך אלעמל לגירה פי תלך אלמדה ועמל פי ארצ'ה בגאיהֵ ג'הדה ונשאטה, פלא יזאל כד'לך חתי יכמל עמל ארצ'ה עלי אכמל מא ינבגי,
קג.en: So whenever he came home from working for another at the close of his day, he would seize the leisure of an hour of it and work his own land with diligence and energy; and whenever there remained over from his wages the provision of a day or more than that, he would leave off working for another during that interval and work his own land with the utmost of his effort and energy; and he continued thus until the working of his land was completed in the most perfect manner that ought to be.

קג.ja: פאד'א בלג וקת את'מארהא ואואן גלתהא חצלה וג'מעה ועאש מנה טול עאמה אלת'אני, פיעמל פי ארצ'ה עלי חכמה, ולא יזאל יסתזיד פי ת'מארה חתי תקום גלתה בקותה, ויפצ'ל לה מא יזיד בה ארצ'א עלי ארצ'ה.
קג.en: And when the time of its fruiting and the season of its yield arrived, he gathered it in and amassed it and lived from it the whole of his second year, working his land with wisdom; and he kept increasing its fruit until its yield sufficed for his sustenance, with a surplus remaining to him whereby he could add land to his land.

קה.en: the trace of the manifest wisdom in the species of the human being, who is the small world — by whom the perfection, order, beauty, ornament, and completion of this world come about, as the Friend (peace be upon him) explained in the Psalm O Lord our Lord (Psalms 8).

קה.ja: ואלרכן אלת'אלת', את'ר אלחכמה אלט'אהרה פי תראכיב אלאנסאן ותאליף ג'סמה וקוי נפסה ונור אלעקל אלד'י כ'צה אללה בה ופצ'לה עלי סאיר אלחיואן אלגיר נאטק, והו משאכל ללעאלם אלכביר ומשאבה לה פי אצולה וענאצרה, ואליה אשאר איוב פי קולה הלא כחלב תתיכני וכגבינה תקפיאני, עור ובשר תלבישני ובעצמות וגידים תסוככני, חיים וחסד עשית עמדי ופקודתך שמרה רוחי.
קה.en: The third pillar: the trace of the manifest wisdom in the composition of the human being and the structure of his body, the faculties of his soul, and the light of the intellect with which God singled him out and made him excel over all the rest of the non-rational animals — and he resembles the great world and is similar to it in its roots and its elements. To this Job pointed in his saying: "Did You not pour me out like milk, and curdle me like cheese? You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews; You granted me life and steadfast love, and Your providence has guarded my spirit" (Job 10:10–12).

קה.en: The fourth pillar: the trace of the manifest wisdom in the kinds of all the rest of the animals, both small and great — among them the flying, the swimming, the crawling, and those of four legs — in the variety of the modes of their forms, their natures, their behaviors, their benefits, and their uses in the world, as is mentioned in God's description to Job when He rebuked him: "Who provides for the raven its prey?" (Job 38:41), and the rest of what He described of the classes of the animals of land and sea.

קו.ja: אלעלום ואלצנאעאת ואלאעמאל אלתי אלהם אללה ג'ל אסמה ללאנסאן לתמאם מצלחתה ואסבאב רזקה וסאיר מנאפעה אלעאמה ואלכ'אצה, ואליהא אשאר אלכתאב בקולה מי שת בטוחות חכמה או מי נתן לשכוי בינה, וקאל אלולי ע"ס כי ה' יתן חכמה מפיו דעת ותבונה.
קו.en: the sciences, the crafts, and the activities by which God (great is His name) has inspired the human being for the completion of his welfare and the causes of his sustenance and the rest of his benefits, both general and particular. To these the Book has pointed in His saying: "Who has put wisdom in the inward parts, or who has given the rooster understanding?" (Job 38:36). And the Friend (peace be upon him) said: "For the Lord gives wisdom; from His mouth knowledge and understanding" (Proverbs 2:6).

קח.en: My brother, that you should ascend in your thought to the beginning of the human being and to the start of his coming-into-being, you will see that the first of God's favors upon him is his being brought into existence after his nonexistence — namely, his emerging from the rank of the elements to the rank of the plant, then he passes from the rank of the plant to the rank of nourishment, and from it he passes to the rank of the seed and the blood, then he passes from it to the rank of the animal, then he passes from it to the rank of the human being, who is the living, speaking, mortal one — and this is by gradation and transformations and varied causes and corresponding intermediaries, composed with a well-ordered governance and a firm arrangement.

קח.ja: פאד'א תאמלת ד'לך וראית את'ר אלג'וד ואלחכמה ואלקדרה פי ג'מיעה, תאמל ופכר פי אצול תאליפה אלט'אהר, אעני נפסה וג'סדה, תרי בדן אלאנסאן מרכבא מן ענאצר מתצ'אדה וטבאיע מכ'תלפה, אלפהא אלכ'אלק תעאלי בקדרתה ורבטהא בחכמתה פאנתט'ם מנהא ג'סם קאים מתחד פי ט'אהרה מכ'תלף פי טבאיעה, ת'ם קרן בה ג'והרא רוחאניא נוראניא משאכלא לרוחאניהֵ אלאשכ'אץ אלעאליה, אעני בהד'א אלג'והר נפסה אלתי רבטהא בוסאיט משאכלה ללטרפין והי אלרוח אלחיואני ואלחרארה אלגריזיה ואלדם ואלערוק ואלעצב ואלשריאנאת, וג'על להא אסבאבא תצונהא ותחפט'הא ותכלוהא מן אלאפאת והי אללחם ואלעט'אם ואלעצ'ל ואלג'לד ואלשער ואלאט'פאר, וג'מיעהא וקאיאת וגלאפאת תצונהא מן אלאפאת.
קח.en: So when you reflect upon that and behold the trace of bounty and wisdom and power in all of it, reflect and ponder upon the manifest principles of his composition — I mean his soul and his body. You will see the body of the human being composed of opposing elements and differing natures, which the Creator (exalted) joined together by His power and bound together by His wisdom, so that there was arranged from them a body subsisting and unified in its exterior, varied in its natures. Then He coupled with it a spiritual, luminous substance, corresponding to the spirituality of the higher beings — I mean by this substance his soul, which He bound with intermediaries corresponding to both extremes: namely the animal spirit, the innate heat, the blood, the veins, the nerves, and the arteries. And He set for it causes that guard it and preserve it and keep it free from harms — namely the flesh, the bones, the muscle, the skin, the hair, and the nails; and all of them are protections and coverings that guard it from harms.

pairs.en: he does not reason and does not discriminate good and evil

pairs.ja: לאנה לו כאן עקלה ותמייזה כאמלין
pairs.en: for had his intellect and discernment been complete
at his upbringing
so that he discriminated the bounty of people over him
in their being self-sufficient
in the swiftness of their movement
and their cleanliness
and saw his own state to the contrary
he would have died of grief and care and chagrin

קי.ja: ומן אלעג'ב פי אמר בכאיה, אן אלטפל ינתפע בה עלי מא זעם אפאצ'ל אלאטבא אן פי אדמגהֵ אלאטפאל רטובה אד'א בקית עלי חאלהא אחדת'ת עליהם אחדאת'א רדיה, פאלבכא יחל תלך אלרטובה ען אדמגתהם ויסלמון מן סו חואדת'הא.
קי.en: And among the wonders in the matter of his weeping is that the infant benefits by it — according to what the most excellent of physicians have claimed, that in the brains of infants there is a moisture which, if it remained in its state, would bring upon them evil afflictions; so the weeping dissolves that moisture from their brains, and they are kept safe from its ill effects.

pairs.en: And among the wonders in the matter of his weeping
is that the infant benefits by it
according to what the most excellent of physicians have claimed
that in the brains of infants there is a moisture
which, if it remained in its state
would bring upon them evil afflictions
so the weeping dissolves that moisture
from their brains
and they are kept safe from its ill effects

קי.ja: ת'ם מן עט'ים לטף אלכ'אלק תעאלי באלאנסאן פי בדלה אסנאנה אלואחד בעד אלאכ'ר ללא יתעד'ר עליה אלאכל טול מדהֵ נבאת מא סקט מנהא.
קי.en: Then, among the great kindness of the Creator (exalted be He) toward the human being is in the replacement of his teeth, one after another, so that eating may not become difficult for him during the whole period of the growth of what has fallen out of them.

pairs.ja: ת'ם מן עט'ים לטף אלכ'אלק תעאלי
pairs.en: Then, among the great kindness of the Creator (exalted be He)
toward the human being
is in the replacement of his teeth
one after another
so that eating may not become difficult for him

pairs.ja: טול מדהֵ נבאת מא סקט מנהא
pairs.en: during the whole period of the growth of what has fallen out of them

קי.ja: ת'ם תעתריה אלאמראץ' ואלאעראץ' אלמולמה לימייז ען אלדניא ולא יג'הל חאלהא פיאנס אליהא ותמלכה שהואתה פיהא פיכון כאלבהימה לא יעקל ולא יפהם, וקאל אלולי אל תהיו כסוס כפרד אין הבין.
קי.en: Then diseases and the painful accidents befall him, so that he may be set apart from the world and not be ignorant of its condition — lest he grow fond of it, and his desires for it take possession of him, and he become like the beast that does not reason and does not understand; and the Friend said: "Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding" (Psalms 32:9).

pairs.en: Then diseases and the painful accidents befall him
so that he may be set apart from the world
and not be ignorant of its condition
lest he grow fond of it
and his desires for it take possession of him
and he become like the beast
that does not reason and does not understand
and the Friend said

pairs.ja: אל תהיו כסוס כפרד אין הבין
pairs.en: "Do not be like a horse or a mule, without understanding"

קי.ja: ת'ם יפכר אלאנסאן בבצר קלבה, פיתאמל מנאפע אעצ'א בדנה ווג'וה מצלחתה בכל עצ'ו מנהא, פאלידאן ללקבץ' ואלדפע, ואלרג'לאן ללנהוץ', ואלעינאן ללאהתדא, ואלאד'נאן ללסמע, ואלאנף ללשם, ואללסאן ללכלאם, ואלפם ללאכל, ואלאסנאן ללקצ'ם, ואלמעדה ללהצ'ם, ואלכבד לתכ'ליץ אלגד'א, ואלמנאפד'
קי.en: Then the human being reflects with the sight of his heart, and considers the benefits of the members of his body and the aspects of their usefulness in each member of them: the two hands for grasping and pushing away, the two feet for rising up, the two eyes for finding the way, the two ears for hearing, the nose for smelling, the tongue for speech, the mouth for eating, the teeth for gnawing, the stomach for digestion, the liver for refining the nourishment, and the passages

pairs.en: Then the human being reflects with the sight of his heart
and considers the benefits of the members of his body
and the aspects of their usefulness in each member of them
the two hands for grasping and pushing away
the two feet for rising up
the two eyes for finding the way
the two ears for hearing
the nose for smelling
the tongue for speech
the mouth for eating
the teeth for gnawing
the stomach for digestion
the liver for refining the nourishment
and the passages

קיא.ja: לאבראז אלפצ'ול, ואלאועיה לחמלהא, ואלקלב מסכן אלחרארה אלגריזיה וינבוע אלחיאה, ואלדמאג מסכן אלקוי אלרוחאניה וינבוע אלחס ואצל אלעצב, ואלפרג' לאקאמהֵ אלנסל, וכד'לך סאיר אעצ'א אלבדן, ואלד'י יכ'פי עלינא מא מנאפעהא אכת'ר ממא יט'הר אלינא.
קיא.en: the channels for the discharge of the excess matter; the receptacles for carrying it; the heart, the dwelling of the innate heat and the spring of life; the brain, the dwelling of the spiritual powers and the spring of sensation, the root of the nerve; the genitals, for the upholding of the offspring. And so for the rest of the members of the body — and what is hidden from us of their benefits is more than what is manifest to us.

pairs.en: for the discharge of the excess matter
the receptacles for carrying it
the heart, the dwelling of the innate heat
and the spring of life
the brain, the dwelling of the spiritual powers
and the spring of sensation
the root of the nerve
the genitals, for the upholding of the offspring
And so for the rest of the members of the body
and what is hidden from us of their benefits
is more than what is manifest to us

קיא.ja: ועלי מת'ל ד'לך תט'הר למן תאמל פי באטן אלבדן ואפעאל אלטביעה פיה ענד ורוד אלגד'א עליה וקסמתה עלי כל ג'ז מן אג'זא אלבדן, וירי מן את'אר אלחכמה מא יוכד עליה אלחמד לכ'אלקה ואלשכר ענה, כקול אלולי כל עצמותי תאמרנה ה' מי כמוך.
קיא.en: The like of this becomes evident to one who reflects on the inside of the body, and the operations of nature within it when the food enters it and is divided to every part of the body's parts; and he sees, of the traces of wisdom, what binds him to praise of his Creator and thanks to Him — as the Friend said: "All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like You?" (Psalms 35:10).

pairs.en: The like of this becomes evident
to one who reflects on the inside of the body
and the operations of nature within it
when the food enters it

pairs.ja: וקסמתה עלי כל ג'ז מן אג'זא אלבדן
pairs.en: and is divided to every part of the body's parts
and he sees, of the traces of wisdom
what binds him to praise of his Creator
and thanks to Him
as the Friend said

pairs.ja: כל עצמותי תאמרנה ה' מי כמוך
pairs.en: All my bones shall say: Lord, who is like You?

קיא.ja: וד'לך אן אלטעאם יציר אלי אלמעדה עלי קנאה מהיאה עלי כ'ט מסתקים לא תקויס פיה ולא אעוג'אג' והו אלמרי, ת'ם תטחנה אלמעדה באבלג מן אלטחין אלאול אלד'י קטעה אלצ'רס,
קיא.en: For the food passes to the stomach through a channel made ready upon a straight line, in which there is neither curving nor crookedness — and that is the gullet; then the stomach grinds it more thoroughly than the first grinding which the molar tooth had performed,

pairs.ja: וד'לך אן אלטעאם יציר אלי אלמעדה
pairs.en: For the food passes to the stomach
through a channel made ready
upon a straight line
in which there is neither curving nor crookedness
and that is the gullet
then the stomach grinds it
more thoroughly than the first grinding
which the molar tooth had performed

קיא.ja: ת'ם תרסלה אלי אלכבד פי ערוק דקאק מתצלה בינהמא קד ג'עלת כאלמצפאה ללגד'א לכי לא יצל אלי אלכבד מנה שי גליט',
קיא.en: then it sends it on to the liver through fine veins joining the two, which have been made like a strainer for the nutriment, so that nothing coarse of it should reach the liver;

pairs.en: then it sends it on to the liver
through fine veins joining the two
which have been made like a strainer for the nutriment

pairs.ja: לכי לא יצל אלי אלכבד מנה שי גליט'
pairs.en: so that nothing coarse of it should reach the liver

קיא.ja: פתקלבה דמא ותקסמה עלי אלבדן ותנפד'ה פי ג'מיע אג'זאיה פי מג'אר מהיאה לד'לך במנזלהֵ אלמג'ארי אלתי תהייא ללמא, וינפד' מא בקי מן אלפצ'ול אלי מג'אר קד אעדת להא,
קיא.en: and it turns it into blood, divides it over the body, and conveys it into all its parts through channels made ready for that — like the watercourses that are prepared for water — and what remains of the excess matter passes off into channels that have been appointed for it:

pairs.en: and it turns it into blood
divides it over the body
and conveys it into all its parts
through channels made ready for that
like the watercourses that are prepared for water
and what remains of the excess matter passes off
into channels that have been appointed for it

קיא.ja: פמא כאן מן ג'נס אלמרה אלצפרא ג'רי אלי כיס אלמרארה, ומא כאן מן ג'נס אלמרה אלסודא ג'רי אלי אלטחאל, ומא כאן מן אלבלה ואלרטובה ג'רי אלי אלריה, ומא כאן מן מצאיהֵ אלדם ג'רי אלי אלמת'אנה.
קיא.en: whatever is of the kind of yellow bile flows to the gall-bladder; whatever is of the kind of black bile flows to the spleen; whatever is of moisture and wetness flows to the lung; and whatever is of the watery part of the blood flows to the bladder.

pairs.ja: פמא כאן מן ג'נס אלמרה אלצפרא
pairs.en: whatever is of the kind of yellow bile
flows to the gall-bladder

pairs.ja: ומא כאן מן ג'נס אלמרה אלסודא
pairs.en: whatever is of the kind of black bile
flows to the spleen
whatever is of moisture and wetness
flows to the lung
whatever is of the watery part of the blood
flows to the bladder

קיא.ja: פתאמל יא אכ'י חכמהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי פי תרכיב בדנך ווצ'עה הד'ה אלאעצ'א מנה מואצ'עהא לתחמל תלך אלפצ'ול פלא ינתשר פי אלבדן ג'מלה פתסקמה.
קיא.en: So reflect, my brother, on the wisdom of the Creator (exalted be He) in the composition of your body, and His setting these members of it in their places to carry off that excess matter, lest it spread through the body altogether and make it sick.

pairs.en: So reflect, my brother
on the wisdom of the Creator (exalted be He)
in the composition of your body
and His setting these members of it in their places
to carry off that excess matter
lest it spread through the body altogether
and make it sick

קיא.ja: ת'ם תאמל פי היאת אלאת אלצות ומכ'ארג' אלכלאם, פאלחנג'רה כאלאנבוב למכ'רג' אלצות, ואללסאן ואלשפתאן ואלאסנאן לתקטיע אלחרוף ואלנגם.
קיא.en: Then reflect on the fashioning of the instruments of the voice and the points of articulation of speech: the larynx is like a pipe for the issuing of the voice, while the tongue, the two lips, and the teeth are for the articulating of the letters and the tunes.

pairs.ja: ת'ם תאמל פי היאת אלאת אלצות
pairs.en: Then reflect on the fashioning of the instruments of the voice
and the points of articulation of speech
the larynx is like a pipe
for the issuing of the voice
while the tongue, the two lips, and the teeth
are for the articulating of the letters and the tunes

קיא.en: And in these members there are benefits

pairs.en: And in these members
there are benefits

קיב.ja: אכ'ר, פפי אלחנג'רה יסלך אלנסים אלי אלריה, ובאללסאן תד'אק אלטעום, ופיה מע ד'לך מעונה עלי אסאגהֵ אלטעאם ואלשראב, ובאלאצ'ראס ימצ'ג אלטעאם, ובאלשפתין יתרשף אלשראב חתי יכון אלד'י ינצב מנה בקצד וקדר, וכד'לך פי סאיר אלאעצ'א מנאפע בעצ'הא מעלומה ובעצ'הא מג'הולה ענדנא.
קיב.en: —as something other. For in the larynx the breath passes to the lungs; by the tongue tastes are tasted, and there is in it besides that an aid for the swallowing of food and drink; by the molars the food is chewed; by the two lips the drink is sipped, so that what flows from them is by intention and measure. And so too in the rest of the members there are benefits, some of which are known to us and some unknown to us.

pairs.en: For in the larynx
the breath passes to the lungs
by the tongue tastes are tasted
and there is in it besides that an aid
for the swallowing of food and drink
by the molars the food is chewed
by the two lips the drink is sipped
so that what flows from them
is by intention and measure
And so too in the rest of the members there are benefits
some of which are known to us
and some unknown to us

קיב.ja: ת'ם תאמל יא אכ'י פי אלקוי אלארבע אלתי פי אלבדן ואפעאלהא פיה,
קיב.en: Then reflect, O my brother, on the four faculties that are in the body and their actions within it:

pairs.en: Then reflect
O my brother
on the four faculties
that are in the body
and their actions within it

קיב.ja: פאלקוה אלג'אד'בה הי אלתי תקתצ'י ורוד אלגד'א ותחצילה פי אלמעדה,
קיב.en: the attractive faculty is the one that requires the arrival of the nourishment and its acquisition in the stomach;

pairs.en: the attractive faculty
is the one that
requires the arrival of the nourishment
and its acquisition in the stomach

קיב.ja: ואלקוה אלמאסכה הי אלתי תחבס אלטעאם ותרדה פי אלמעדה חתי תפעל אלטביעה פיה פעלהא,
קיב.en: the retentive faculty is the one that holds the food and keeps it in the stomach until nature performs its action upon it;

pairs.en: the retentive faculty
holds the food
and keeps it in the stomach
until nature performs its action upon it

קיב.ja: ואלקוה אלהאצ'מה הי אלתי תטבכ'ה ותסתכ'רג' צפותה ותבת'ה פי אלבדן,
קיב.en: the digestive faculty is the one that cooks it, extracts its pure essence, and disperses it through the body;

pairs.en: the digestive faculty
cooks it
extracts its pure essence
and disperses it through the body

קיב.ja: ואלקוה אלדאפעה הי אלתי תחדר אלתפל אלפאצ'ל בעד אכ'ד' אלקוה אלהאצ'מה חאג'תהא מן אלגד'א.
קיב.en: and the expulsive faculty is the one that sends down the residue left over after the digestive faculty has taken its need from the nourishment.

pairs.en: and the expulsive faculty
sends down the residue left over
after the digestive faculty has taken
its need from the nourishment

קיב.ja: פאנט'ר כיף וכלת הד'ה אלקוי פי אלבדן ללקיאם עליה במא פיה צלאחה.
קיב.en: So consider how these faculties were appointed in the body to attend to it with what is for its welfare.

pairs.en: So consider how
these faculties were appointed in the body
to attend to it
with what is for its welfare

קיב.ja: פצארת במנזלהֵ דאר ללמלך פיהא חשם וקואם מוכלון באלדאר,
קיב.en: Thus they became like a house belonging to the king, in which are attendants and stewards charged with the house:

pairs.en: Thus they became like a house belonging to the king
in which are attendants and stewards
charged with the house

קיב.ja: פואחד לאקתצ'א חואיג' אלחשם ואיראדהא אלי כ'אזן אלמלך,
קיב.en: one to procure the needs of the household and bring them to the king's storekeeper;

pairs.en: one
to procure the needs of the household
and bring them to the king's storekeeper

קיב.ja: וקיים ת'אן יקבץ' מא יורדה אלאול ויכ'זנה פי אלדאר אלי אן יהייא ויצלח,
קיב.en: a second steward to receive what the first brings in and store it in the house until it is made ready and fit;

pairs.en: a second steward
to receive what the first brings in
and store it in the house
until it is made ready and fit

קיב.ja: וקיים ת'אלת' לעלאג' מא אכ'תזן ואצלאחה ותהייתה ותפרקתה פי אלחשם,
קיב.en: a third steward to treat what has been stored, set it right, prepare it, and distribute it among the household;

pairs.en: a third steward
to treat what has been stored
set it right, prepare it
and distribute it among the household

קיב.ja: וקיים ראבע לכסח מא פי אלדאר מן אלאקד'אר ואלאוסאך' ואכ'ראג'הא מנהא.
קיב.en: and a fourth steward to clear away whatever is in the house of filth and refuse and to remove it from it.

pairs.en: and a fourth steward
to clear away whatever is in the house
of filth and refuse
and to remove it from it

קיב.ja: ת'ם פכר פי אלקוי אלנפסאניה ומואקעהא מן מנאפע אלאנסאן, נחו אלפכר ואלחפט' ואלנסיאן ואלחיא ואלעקל ואלנטק,
קיב.en: Then ponder the psychic faculties and their bearing upon the benefits of man, such as thought, memory, forgetting, shame, intellect, and speech.

pairs.en: Then ponder
the psychic faculties
and their bearing upon the benefits of man
such as thought
memory
forgetting
shame
intellect
and speech

קיב.ja: פראית לו נקץ אלאנסאן מן הד'ה אלכ'לאל אלחפט' וחדה כיף כאנת תכון חאלה,
קיב.en: For consider: were man to be deprived, out of these qualities, of memory alone, how would his condition be,

pairs.en: For consider
were man to be deprived
out of these qualities
of memory alone
how would his condition be

קיב.ja: וכם מן כ'לל כאן סידכ'ל עליה פי אמורה אד'א לם יחפט' מא לה ומא עליה, ומא אכ'ד' ומא אעטי, ומא ראי ומא סמע, ומא קאל ומא קיל לה, ולם יד'כר
קיב.en: and how much disorder would befall him in his affairs were he not to remember what is owed to him and what he owes, what he took and what he gave, what he saw and what he heard, what he said and what was said to him, and did not recall—

pairs.en: and how much disorder
would befall him in his affairs
were he not to remember
what is owed to him and what he owes
what he took and what he gave
what he saw and what he heard
what he said and what was said to him
and did not recall

קיג.ja: מן אחסן אליה ממן אסא אליה, ומא נפעה ממא צ'רה, ת'ם לם יהתד אלי טריק ולו סלכה מרארא כת'ירה, ולא יחפט' עלמא ולו דרסה טול עמרה.
קיג.en: [He would not distinguish] the one who treated him well from the one who treated him ill, nor what benefits him from what harms him; moreover he would not find his way along a road even though he had traveled it many times, nor would he retain a piece of knowledge even though he had studied it his whole life long.

pairs.en: the one who treated him well
from the one who treated him ill
nor what benefits him
from what harms him
he would not find his way along a road
even though he had traveled it many times
nor would he retain a piece of knowledge
even though he had studied it his whole life long

קיג.ja: ולא ינתפע בתג'רבה, ולא יקיס שיא במא מצ'י.
קיג.en: He would not profit from experience, nor measure anything by what has passed,

pairs.en: He would not profit from experience
nor measure anything
by what has passed

קיג.ja: ולא מא יכון במא כאן, בל כאן כ'ליקא אן ינסלך' מן אלאנסאניה אצלא.
קיג.en: nor judge what is to be by what has been; rather he would deserve to be stripped of humanity altogether.

pairs.en: nor judge what is to be
by what has been
rather he would deserve
to be stripped of humanity
altogether

קיג.ja: ומן כ'צאל אלנסיאן אן לולאה מא סלא אחד ען מציבה, ולא שגלה ענהא שי מן סרור אלדניא, ולא אלתד' במא יסרה אד'א תד'כר אפאת אלדניא, ולא רג'א פתרה מן חאסד, ולא גפלה מן סלטאן.
קיג.en: And among the virtues of forgetting is that, were it not for it, no one would be consoled after a calamity, nor would any of the joys of this world divert him from it, nor would he take pleasure in what gladdens him when he recalled the misfortunes of this world, nor hope for a respite from an envier, nor for heedlessness on the part of a ruler.

pairs.en: among the virtues of forgetting
were it not for it
no one would be consoled after a calamity

pairs.ja: ולא שגלה ענהא שי מן סרור אלדניא
pairs.en: nor would any of the joys of this world divert him from it
nor would he take pleasure in what gladdens him
when he recalled the misfortunes of this world
nor hope for a respite from an envier
nor for heedlessness on the part of a ruler

קיג.ja: אפלא תרי כיף ג'על פי אלאנסאן אלחפט' ואלנסיאן והמא מכ'תלפאן מתצ'אדאן, וג'על לה פי כל ואחד מנהמא צ'רובא מן אלמצלחה.
קיג.en: Do you not see how memory and forgetting have been placed in the human being, though the two are different and opposed, and how He has set for him in each one of them sorts of benefit?

pairs.en: Do you not see
how
memory and forgetting

sorts of benefit

קיג.ja: ת'ם פכר פי כ'לק אלחיא אלד'י כ'ץ אלאנסאן בה מא אכבר קדרה ואעט'ם פאידתה ומצלחתה, פלולאה לם יקר אלצ'יף, ולם יוף באלועד, ולם תקץ' אלחואיג', ולא ינג'ז אלג'מיל ויג'תנב אלקביח פי שי מן אלאשיא, חתי אן כת'ירא מן אלאמור אלשריעיה אנמא תג'על ללחיא, פאן אכת'ר ג'מהור אלנאס לולא אלחיא לם יראעוא חקא לאבאיהם פצ'לא ען סואהם.
קיג.en: Then reflect on the creation of shame, with which the human being has been singled out — how great is its measure and how immense its benefit and its usefulness; for were it not for it, no guest would be honored, no promise fulfilled, no needs met, nor would the good be carried out and the ugly avoided in any matter at all — so much so that many of the religious-legal precepts are instituted only on account of shame; for most of the mass of people, were it not for shame, would not observe a duty toward their own fathers, let alone toward anyone else.

קיג.ja: ולם יודוא אמאנה, ולם יעפוא ען פאחשה, ומן אתי שיא ממא ד'כרנא אנמא יאתיה בעד כ'לע ת'וב אלחיא ענה כקול אלולי ע"ס גם בוש לא יבושו גם הכלים לא ידעו, וקאל ולא ידע עול בשת.
קיג.en: Nor would they discharge a trust, nor refrain from an indecency; and whoever commits any of the things we have mentioned does so only after stripping off from himself the garment of shame, as the prophet (peace be upon him) said: "They were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush" (Jer. 6:15), and he said: "but the unjust knoweth no shame" (Zeph. 3:5).

as the prophet

קיג.ja: ומן אלעג'ב יא אכ'י אנה רזק אלאנסאן אלחיא מן אלנאס למא וצפנא מן מנאפעה בה ולמא הו אכת'ר מנה לם יחט בה וצפנא, ולם יג'על פי טבעה אלחיא מן אללה עז וג'ל אלמטלע עליה דאימא לכי (למא) ל[א] יכון מג'בורא עלי טאעתה לה פיצ'עף וג'ה אסתחקאקה לת'ואב טאעתה, לכן ילזמנא אלחיא מן אללה בטריק אלאעתבאר ואלעלם במא ילזמנא לה מן
קיג.en: And it is among the wonders, O my brother, that He provided the human being with shame before people — because of the benefits in it that we have described, and because of what is even greater than that, which our description cannot encompass — yet He did not place in his nature shame before God (mighty and exalted), who is forever watching over him, so that he would not be compelled to obey Him, which would weaken the basis of his deserving reward for his obedience; rather, shame before God is incumbent upon us by way of reflection and knowledge of what we owe Him of

קיד.ja: אלטאעה, ועלמנא באטלאעה עלי ט'ואהרנא וצ'מאירנא, כקולה בושו והכלמו מדרכיכם בית ישראל.
קיד.en: obedience, and He has informed us of His being aware of our outward deeds and our inner thoughts, as in His saying: "Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel" (Ezekiel 36:32).

קיד.ja: ואמא עט'ים נעמהֵ אללה עז וג'ל עלינא פי אלעקל ואלתמייז אלד'י כ'צנא בהמא דון סאיר אנואע אלבשריין, פליס תכ'פי פאידהֵ ד'לך לנא פי תדביר אג'סאמנא ונט'אם חרכאתנא, דון מן פקד מנא ד'לך לאפה תערץ' פי דמאגה.
קיד.en: As for the greatness of God's bounty (mighty and exalted) upon us in the intellect and the faculty of discernment with which He singled us out from all the other kinds of mankind — the benefit of that to us in the governance of our bodies and the ordering of our movements is not hidden, in contrast to one among us who has lost that through some affliction befalling his brain.

קיד.ja: ואמא אלכ'צאל אלתי תחצל לנא מן אג'ל אלעקל פכת'ירה ג'דא.
קיד.en: As for the qualities that accrue to us by reason of the intellect, they are very many.

קיד.ja: מן ד'לך אלאסתדלאל בה עלי אן לנא כ'אלקא חכימא פרדא צמדא ואחדא אזליא קאדרא, לא יחוט בה זמאן ולא מכאן, ג'ל ען אוצאף אלמכ'לוקין, ותעאלי ען אוהאם אלמוג'ודין, רחימא כרימא ג'ואדא, לא ישבה שיא ולא ישבהה שי.
קיד.en: Among these is the inference by means of it that we have a Creator: wise, single, eternal-and-self-sufficient, one, everlasting, powerful — whom neither time nor place encompasses, exalted above the descriptions of created things, and lofty above the imaginings of existent beings — merciful, generous, bountiful, who resembles nothing and whom nothing resembles.

one, everlasting, powerful

קיד.ja: ומן ד'לך איצ'א פהמנא בה אלחכמה ואלקדרה ואלרחמה אלמבת'ות'ה פי אלעאלם, ווג'וב אלטאעה לה ואלעבאדה למא הו אהלה, ומן אג'ל נעמתה אלשאמלה ואלכ'אצה.
קיד.en: And among these too: by means of it we apprehend the wisdom, the power, and the mercy diffused throughout the world, and the obligation of obedience to Him and of worship of the One who is worthy of it, on account of His all-embracing and His particular bounty.

קיד.ja: ובאלעקל יצח לנא כתאב אללה אלצאדק אלמוחי בה אלי רסולה ע"ס אלד'י תעברנא בה.
קיד.en: And by the intellect there is established as valid for us the truthful Book of God, revealed to His messenger (peace be upon him), by which He has imposed obligations upon us.

קיד.ja: ובקדר עקל אלאנסאן ותמייזה יקע אלחסאב ואלתקצי עליה מן אללה תעאלי ד'כרה.
קיד.en: And in proportion to a person's intellect and his discernment falls the reckoning and the inquiry against him from God, exalted be His mention.

pairs.en: And in proportion to a person's intellect and his discernment
falls the reckoning and the inquiry against him

קיד.ja: ומן פקד עקלה סקטת ענה פצ'איל אלאנסאניה ג'מלה וכלפהם ות'ואבהם ועקאבהם.
קיד.en: And whoever has lost his intellect — there fall away from him the excellences of humanity altogether, together with their obligations, their reward, and their punishment.

pairs.en: And whoever has lost his intellect
there fall away from him
the excellences of humanity altogether
together with their obligations, their reward, and their punishment

קיד.ja: ומן כ'צאל אלעקל אן בה ידרך אלאנסאן ג'מיע מדרכאתה אלמחסוסה ואלמעקולה, ובה ירי מא גאב ען חואסה אלג'סמאניה מן אלמראיאת, כאנתקאל אלט'ל, ותאת'יר אלנקטה אלואחדה מן אלמא פי אלחג'ר אלצלד, ובה יפצל בין אלחק ואלבאטל, ובין אלפאצ'ל ואלנאקץ, ובין אלכ'יר ואלשר, ובין אלג'מיל ואלקביח, ובין אלואג'ב ואלממכן ואלממתנע.
קיד.en: And among the qualities of the intellect is that by it a person apprehends all his perceptibles, both the sensed and the intelligible; and by it he sees what is hidden from his bodily senses among visible phenomena — such as the moving of the shadow, and the effect of a single drop of water upon hard rock; and by it he distinguishes between truth and falsehood, between the superior and the deficient, between good and evil, between the beautiful and the ugly, and between the necessary, the possible, and the impossible.

pairs.en: And among the qualities of the intellect
is that by it a person apprehends
all his perceptibles, both the sensed and the intelligible

pairs.ja: ובה ירי מא גאב ען חואסה אלג'סמאניה
pairs.en: and by it he sees what is hidden from his bodily senses

and by it he distinguishes between truth and falsehood
between the superior and the deficient

קיד.ja: ובה יסכ'ר סאיר אנואע אלחיואן פי מצאלחה ומנאפעה, ובה ימייז ען מואצ'ע
קיד.en: And by it he subjugates all the kinds of animals to his interests and his benefits; and by it he discerns the places

קטו.ja: אלכואכב ואבעאדהא, וחרכאת אלאפלאך, ואלנסב ואלמקאיס אלהנדסיה ואשכאל אלבראהין אלמנטקיה וסאיר אלעלום ואלצנאעאת אלתי יטול ד'כרהא.
קטו.en: the stars and their distances, the motions of the spheres, the geometric proportions and measures, the figures of logical demonstrations, and the rest of the sciences and crafts whose mention would be long.

קטו.ja: וכד'לך סאיר אכ'לאק אלאנסאן אד'א אעתברתהא וג'דתהא פי גאיה מן אלמצלחה ואלמנפעה לה עלי מת'ל מא וצפנא פי אלעקל.
קטו.en: And likewise the rest of the human's traits: if you reflect upon them, you will find them to be at the utmost of benefit and advantage to him, just as we described concerning the intellect.

קטו.ja: ת'ם פכר פי מא אנעם אללה בה עלי אלאנסאן פי אלנטק ונט'אם אלכלאם אלד'י יעבר בה עמא פי נפסה וצ'מירה, ויפהם בה ען גירה,
קטו.en: Then reflect upon what God has graciously bestowed upon the human in speech and the ordering of language, by which he expresses what is in his soul and his mind, and by which he understands from another —

pairs.en: Then reflect

pairs.ja: פי מא אנעם אללה בה עלי אלאנסאן
pairs.en: upon what God has graciously bestowed upon the human
in speech
and the ordering of language
by which he expresses
what is in his soul and his mind
and by which he understands from another

קטו.ja: ואללסאן קלם אלקלב ותרג'מאן אלנפס וספיר אלצ'מיר, ולולא אלכלאם לאנקטע אנס אלאנסאן במן יאלפה וכאן כאלבהימה.
קטו.en: for the tongue is the pen of the heart, the interpreter of the soul, and the emissary of the mind; and were it not for speech, the human's intimacy with those he keeps company with would be severed, and he would be like a beast.

pairs.en: for the tongue is the pen of the heart

קטו.ja: ובאלכלאם יט'הר אלתפאצ'ל בין אלנאס, ובה תנעקד אלעהוד בינהם ובין אללה ובין אוליאה,
קטו.en: By speech the differences in rank among people become manifest, and by it covenants are contracted among them, and between them and God, and between them and His friends,

pairs.en: By speech
the differences in rank among people become manifest

among them, and between them and God
and between them and His friends

קטו.ja: ובאלכלאם יסתדרך אלזלל ותסתגפר אלד'נוב, והו אקוי דליל עלי פצ'איל אלנאס ורד'אילהם.
קטו.en: and by speech slips are amended and forgiveness is sought for sins, and it is the strongest indication of people's virtues and their vices.

קטו.ja: וקיל אנמא אלאנסאן אלקלב ואללסאן, ובה כמאל חד אלאנסאן, אעני אלנטק, אד' חד אלאנסאן חי נאטק מית, ובה ינפצל מן אלבהאים.
קטו.en: And it has been said: the human is but the heart and the tongue; and by it the definition of the human is completed — I mean speech — since the definition of the human is "a living, speaking, mortal being," and by it he is distinguished from the beasts.

קטו.ja: ת'ם פכר פי פצ'איל רסום אלכ'ט ואלכתאבה אלתי בהא תקייד את'אר אלמאצ'יין ואלחאצ'רין ללמסתאנפין, ותוצל אכ'באר אלגאיבין ללחאצ'רין, ואחואל אלמתגרבין אלי אקראבהם,
קטו.en: Then reflect upon the excellences of the forms of script and writing, by which the traces of the past and present are recorded for those who come after, and the reports of the absent are conveyed to those present, and the conditions of those far from home to their kin,

קטו.ja: אלד'י רבמא כאן פי תאדיתהא אליהם חיאתהם ואסתנקאד'הם מן אלבלאיא ואלהלאכאת, ובה תכ'לד אלעלום פי אלכתב, ובה תנט'ם אלמעאני אלמפתרקה פי אלצדור, ובה יעלק אלנאס מא ג'רי בינהם מן מעאמלה
קטו.en: in the conveying of which to them there may lie their very life and their rescue from calamities and destructions; and by it the sciences are made to endure in books, and by it the meanings scattered in the breasts are set in order, and by it people record the dealings that have passed between them.

קטז.ja: ותג'ארה ודין ושרא ארץ' וצדאק וטלאק ועתאק, ואלאמר אכת'ר מן אן נחוט בה.
קטז.en: and trade, debt, the buying of land, marriage-contract, divorce, and manumission — and the matter is greater than we can encompass.

קטז.ja: ומן תמאם אלנעמה עלי אלאנסאן פיה, מא היי לה כף ואצאבע יחכם בהא אלרסם ואלכ'ט ואלרקם ואזנאד אלנאר וסאיר אלאעמאל ואלצנאעאת אללטיפה, דון סאיר אנואע אלחיואן אלבשרי לאסתגנאיהם ענהא.
קטז.en: And among the perfection of the blessing upon the human in it is that He has prepared for him a palm and fingers by which he masters drawing, writing, inscribing, the striking of sparks for fire, and the rest of subtle activities and crafts — apart from the other species of the human animal, since these have no need of them.

קטז.ja: ואקול מא מן עצ'ו ד'כרת וג'וה מנאפעה אלא ואת'ר אלחכמה פי תרכיבה ווצ'עה ותאליפה ט'אהרה למן תפהמהא, והי קויהֵ אלשהאדה ואצ'חהֵ אלדלאלה עלי ענאיהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי בנא.
קטז.en: And I say: there is no organ whose aspects of benefit I have mentioned except that the trace of wisdom in its composition, its placement, and its assembly is manifest to whoever understands it — and it is strong in testimony and clear in indication of the care of the Creator, exalted be He, for us.

קטז.ja: וקד שרח לנא ג'אלינוס פי כתאב מנאפע אלאעצ'א שרחא בליגא, ולו קצדנא שרח ד'לך פי עצ'ו ואחד פקט לכ'רג' בנא אלכלאם ען חד אלקצד, ופי מא ג'לבנא בעץ' אלתנביה למן רשד אלי מא פיה נג'אתה אן שא אללה.
קטז.en: Galen has expounded this for us in the Book of the Uses of the Organs with an eloquent exposition; and were we to aim at expounding that with respect to a single organ alone, our discourse would carry us beyond the bound of our purpose. In what we have adduced there is some measure of arousal for whoever is rightly guided to that in which lies his deliverance, if God wills.
