to that in which lies his deliverance
if God wills

קטז.ja: ואמא אלאעתבאר בסאיר אצנאף אלחיואן ותדבירהא ומעאשהא פליס יכ'פי ען מן תאמלהא ותפהם את'אר אלחכמה פיהא, ולד'לך תרי אלכתאב ירדדהא ענד ד'כרה עג'איב אלכ'אלק תעאלי במא קאלה לאיוב מי יכין לעורב צידו כי ילדיו אל אל ישועו, וקאל נותן לבהמה לחמה לבני עורב אשר יקראו, וכת'יר מת'לה.
קטז.en: As for reflection upon the rest of the kinds of animals, their governance, and their sustenance — this is not hidden from whoever contemplates them and understands the traces of wisdom in them. For this reason you see Scripture repeating them when it mentions the wonders of the Creator, exalted be He, as in what He said to Job: "Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young cry out to God"; and it said: "He gives to the beast its food, to the young ravens that call"; and much like it.

pairs.en: As for reflection
upon the rest of the kinds of animals
their governance, and their sustenance
this is not hidden
from whoever contemplates them
and understands the traces of wisdom in them
For this reason you see Scripture repeating them
when it mentions the wonders of the Creator, exalted be He
as in what He said to Job

pairs.ja: מי יכין לעורב צידו כי ילדיו אל אל ישועו
pairs.en: Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young cry out to God
and it said

pairs.ja: נותן לבהמה לחמה לבני עורב אשר יקראו
pairs.en: He gives to the beast its food, to the young ravens that call
and much like it

קטז.ja: וכד'לך אד'א נט'רת אלי ג'רי אלאפלאך אלמכ'תלפה בחרכאת מכ'תלפה ואנואר מכ'תלפה לאנתט'אם חאל אלכל בהא, ראית מן את'אר אלקדרה ואלחכמה מא לא יחיט בה והם אלאנסאן, ויעג'ז ען צפתה בלסאנה, כקול אלולי השמים מספרים כבוד אל ומעשה ידיו מגיד הרקיע, וסאיר אלמזמור, וקאל כי אראה שמיך מעשה אצבעותיך ירח וכוכבים אשר
קטז.en: Likewise, when you look at the coursing of the diverse spheres with diverse motions and diverse lights, by which the state of the whole is set in order, you see of the traces of power and wisdom that which the human's imagination cannot encompass, and the description of which his tongue is too weak to render — as in the saying of the friend [of God]: "The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament tells the work of His hands," and the rest of the psalm; and he said: "When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars which..."

pairs.en: Likewise, when you look
at the coursing of the diverse spheres
with diverse motions and diverse lights
by which the state of the whole is set in order
you see of the traces of power and wisdom

pairs.ja: מא לא יחיט בה והם אלאנסאן
pairs.en: that which the human's imagination cannot encompass
the description of which his tongue is too weak to render
as in the saying of the friend [of God]

pairs.ja: השמים מספרים כבוד אל ומעשה ידיו מגיד הרקיע
pairs.en: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament tells the work of His hands
and the rest of the psalm
and he said

pairs.ja: כי אראה שמיך מעשה אצבעותיך ירח וכוכבים אשר
pairs.en: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars which
which You have established

קיז.ja: ומן אעג'ב מא יקע עליה בצר אלאנסאן מן מכ'לוקאת אלבארי תעאלי אלג'סימה פהי אלסמא,
קיז.en: Among the most wondrous of the corporeal creatures of the Creator (exalted be He) upon which the sight of man falls is the heaven,

pairs.en: Among the most wondrous
upon which the sight of man falls
creatures of the Creator (exalted be He)
the corporeal
is the heaven

קיז.ja: פאנה חית' וקף מן אלארץ' ירי נצף אלפלך אלד'י יחיט באלארץ',
קיז.en: for wherever he stands upon the earth he sees half of the sphere that surrounds the earth,

pairs.en: for wherever he stands
upon the earth
he sees half of the sphere
that surrounds the earth

קיז.ja: פאד'א נט'ר אלנאט'ר אליה מעתברא ראי אן אלד'י כ'לקה במשייתה לא יתנאהי פי קדרתה וחכמתה וג'לאלתה,
קיז.en: and when the observer looks upon it reflectively, he sees that the One who created it by His will is without limit in His power, His wisdom, and His majesty;

pairs.en: and when the observer looks upon it
reflectively
he sees
that the One who created it by His will
is without limit
in His power, His wisdom, and His majesty

קיז.ja: פאנא אד'א ארינא מן את'אר בניאן אלכ'לק אלקדים שיא תעג'בנא מן קדרתהם עלי מת'לה,
קיז.en: for when we are shown something of the traces of the buildings of the ancients, we marvel at their capacity for the like of it,

pairs.en: for when we are shown
something of the traces of the buildings of the ancients
something
we marvel
at their capacity for the like of it

קיז.ja: ודלנא עלי קוהֵ אבדאנהם ועלו הממהם פי תחצינהם עלי אנפסהם,
קיז.en: and it points us to the strength of their bodies and the loftiness of their resolve in fortifying themselves;

pairs.en: and it points us
to the strength of their bodies
and the loftiness of their resolve
in fortifying themselves

קיז.ja: פאד'א עט'ם עלינא הד'א אלנזר אליסיר ואלאת'ר אלחקיר אלד'י לא יפצ'ל עלי עמלנא אלא באליסיר,
קיז.en: so when this slight glance and paltry trace—which exceeds our own work only by a little—looms great in our eyes,

pairs.en: looms great in our eyes
this slight glance
and paltry trace

pairs.ja: אלד'י לא יפצ'ל עלי עמלנא אלא באליסיר
pairs.en: which exceeds our own work only by a little

קיז.ja: כם יג'ב אן יעט'ם מן כ'אלק אלארץ' ואלסמא ומא בינהמא דון כלפה ולא משקה ולא נצב ולא ענא,
קיז.en: how much more ought there to loom great the Maker of the earth and the heaven and what is between them—without effort, without toil, without weariness, without travail,

pairs.en: how much more ought there to loom great
the Maker of the earth and the heaven
and what is between them
without effort
without toil
without weariness
without travail

קיז.ja: ולא מן שי ולא עלי שי ולא בשי, בל באראדתה ומשייתה,
קיז.en: neither out of anything, nor upon anything, nor by anything, but rather by His will and His volition,

pairs.en: neither out of anything
nor upon anything
nor by anything
but rather by His will and His volition

קיז.ja: כקולה בדבר ה' שמים נעשו וברוח פיו כל צבאם.
קיז.en: as in His saying: "By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of His mouth" (Psalms 33:6).

pairs.en: as in His saying
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made
and all their host by the breath of His mouth

קיז.ja: ומן ג'מלהֵ אלנעם עלי אלאנסאן אן כלמא תאמלת את'אר אלחכמה פי אלמכ'לוקין תג'דהא מע שהאדתהא ללכ'אלק תעאלי באלרבוביה ואלוחדאניה לא תנפך מן אן יכון פיהא ללאנסאן וג'ה מנפעה וקצד מצלחה,
קיז.en: And among the sum of the favors toward man is that, whenever you reflect upon the traces of wisdom in created things, you find them—together with their witness to the Creator (exalted be He) of His lordship and His oneness—never devoid of there being in them, for man, some aspect of benefit and some intent of welfare,

pairs.en: And among the sum of the favors toward man
is that, whenever you reflect
upon the traces of wisdom in created things
you find them
together with their witness to the Creator (exalted be He)
of His lordship and His oneness
never devoid
of there being in them, for man
some aspect of benefit
and some intent of welfare

קיז.ja: אלא אן בעצ'הא ואצ'חה ובעצ'הא כ'פייה.
קיז.en: except that some of it is clear and some of it is hidden.

pairs.en: except that
some of it is clear
and some of it is hidden

קיז.ja: ומן ד'לך אלנור ואלט'למה, פאן פואיד אלנור ט'אהרה באדיה לא תכ'פו,
קיז.en: An instance of this is light and darkness: for the benefits of light are evident and apparent, not hidden,

pairs.en: An instance of this is
light and darkness
for the benefits of light
are evident and apparent
not hidden

קיז.ja: ואמא אלט'למה פכ'פייהֵ אלמנאפע, לאסתיחאש אלנאס בהא ואנקטאע אעמאלהם וחרכאתהם ענד חלולהא,
קיז.en: but as for darkness, its benefits are hidden, because of people's dread of it and the cessation of their labors and movements when it sets in;

pairs.en: but as for darkness
its benefits are hidden
because of people's dread of it
and the cessation of their labors and movements
when it sets in

קיז.ja: ולולא ט'למהֵ אלליל לאנקטעת אבדאן אכת'ר אלחיואן באתצאל תעבהא ודואם עמלהא וטול חרכתהא.
קיז.en: and were it not for the darkness of the night, the bodies of most animals would break down through the unbrokenness of their toil, the persistence of their labor, and the length of their movement.

pairs.en: and were it not for the darkness of the night
the bodies of most animals would break down
through the unbrokenness of their toil
the persistence of their labor
and the length of their movement

קיז.ja: ובאלליל ינפצל בעץ' אלזמאן מן בעצ'ה, ובה תחצל אלמדד אלמג'הולה וטול אלאג'אל מן קצרהא.
קיז.en: And by the night one part of time is set off from another, and by it are determined the unknown durations and the length of life-spans as against their shortness.

pairs.en: And by the night
one part of time is set off from another
and by it are determined
the unknown durations
and the length of life-spans as against their shortness

קיז.ja: ולו כאנת אלחאל דאימה עלי צורה ואחדה לם תכן שריעה מצ'מנה בזמאן מת'ל אלסבת
קיז.en: And were the state to remain perpetually in a single form, there would be no commandment bound to a time, such as the Sabbath.

pairs.en: And were the state to remain perpetually
in a single form
there would be no commandment
bound to a time
such as the Sabbath

קיח.ja: ואלעיד ואלצום, ולא כאן בין אלנאס ועד אלי וקת מחדוד, וג'הל מן אלמעלומאת אלמצ'מנה בזמאן אכת'רהא, ולא יתם הצ'ם אלטעאם פי מעדהֵ אחד מן אלחיואן עלי כמאלה.
קיח.en: and the festival, and the fast; and there would be no appointed time among people up to a fixed moment; and ignorance of most of the things contained in time; and the digestion of food in the stomach of any animal would not have been completed in its fullness.

pairs.en: and the festival, and the fast
and there would be no appointed time among people
up to a fixed moment
and ignorance of most of the things
contained in time
and the digestion of food
in the stomach of any animal
in its fullness

קיח.ja: ולמא כאן אלאנסאן מחתאג'א אלי אלצ'יא באלליל ליעמל פיה בעץ' אעמאלה ויאנס בה אלעליל באלליל, עווצ'ה אללה מנה בצ'יא אלנאר, ליסתעמלה באלליל מתי שא ויטפיה מתי שא.
קיח.en: Since the human had need of light by night to do some of his works in it, and that the sick one might be cheered by it at night, God compensated him for it with the light of fire, that he might employ it by night whenever he wills and extinguish it whenever he wills.

pairs.en: Since the human had need
of light by night
to do some of his works in it
and that the sick one might be cheered by it at night
God compensated him for it
with the light of fire
that he might employ it by night
whenever he wills
and extinguish it whenever he wills

קיח.ja: ומן אלעג'ב אן יכון לון אלסמא ממא יקוי אלבצר, אעני מאילא אלי אלסואד.
קיח.en: And among the wonders is that the color of the sky is among the things that strengthen the sight — I mean, its inclining toward blackness.

pairs.en: And among the wonders
is that the color of the sky
is among the things that strengthen the sight
I mean, its inclining
toward blackness

קיח.ja: ומן כ'אצתה אנה ג'אמע ללבצר ומקו לה, ולו כאן אביץ' אללון לאצ'ר בבצר אלחיואן ואצ'עף קוהֵ אלעין, וכד'לך סר אלחכמה פי סאיר אלמכ'לוקאת.
קיח.en: And among its special properties is that it gathers the sight and strengthens it; and were its color white it would harm the sight of the animal and weaken the power of the eye. And likewise is the secret of wisdom in all the rest of created things.

pairs.en: And among its special properties
is that it gathers the sight
and strengthens it
and were its color white
it would harm the sight of the animal
and weaken the power of the eye
And likewise is the secret of wisdom
in all the rest of created things

קיח.ja: ומן עט'ים נעמהֵ אללה עלי אלאנסאן אנה מהיב עלי סאיר אלחיואן אלמוד'י, כמא קאל אלכתאב ומוראכם וחתכם יהיה על כל חית הארץ, חתי יכון אלטפל יומן עליה מן אלסנור ואלפאר ומא אשבה ד'לך, ואד'א מאת אלרג'ל לם יומן עליה ממא ד'כרנא מן אלחיואן, כקול אואילנא ע"ס תינוק בן יומו חי אין צריך לשמרו מן העכברים, עוג מלך הבשן מת צריך לשמרו מן העכברים, שנאמר ומראכם וחתכם יהיה על כל חית הארץ.
קיח.en: And among the great blessings of God upon the human is that he is held in awe by all the rest of the harmful animals, as Scripture said: "And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth" (Genesis 9:2) — so much so that the infant is kept safe from the cat and the mouse and the like, while when the man dies he is not kept safe from what we have mentioned of the animals, as our early sages said, peace be upon them: "A one-day-old infant, alive, needs no guarding from the mice; Og king of Bashan, dead, needs guarding from the mice — as it is said: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth."

pairs.en: And among the great blessings of God
upon the human

pairs.ja: אנה מהיב עלי סאיר אלחיואן אלמוד'י
pairs.en: is that he is held in awe by all the rest of the harmful animals
as Scripture said
so much so that the infant is kept safe
from the cat and the mouse
and the like
while when the man dies
he is not kept safe
from what we have mentioned of the animals
as our early sages said

קיח.ja: וממא יג'ב לך אן תפהם מן ג'מלהֵ אלמכ'לוקאת אעלאהא ואספלהא דקיקהא וג'לילהא, אלמעני אלכ'פי אלד'י בה נט'אם אלכל ותמאמה, ולא ידרך באלחואס אלג'סמאניה, והי אלחרכה אללאזמה לכל מולף, ולא תדרכהא חאסה מן אלחואס אלג'סמאניה, ואנמא ידרכהא אלעקל בתוסט אלמתחרך אלד'י תדרכה אלחואס, ולולא אלחרכה לם יתם כון לשי מן
קיח.en: And among what you are obliged to understand from the totality of created things — their highest and their lowest, their subtle and their grand — is the hidden meaning by which the order of the whole and its completeness subsist, which is not grasped by the bodily senses: namely the motion that necessarily belongs to every composite thing. No one of the bodily senses grasps it; rather the intellect grasps it through the mediation of the moving thing which the senses do grasp. And were it not for motion, the being of nothing would be completed of

pairs.en: And among what you are obliged to understand
from the totality of created things
their highest and their lowest
their subtle and their grand
is the hidden meaning
by which the order of the whole and its completeness subsist
which is not grasped by the bodily senses
namely the motion that necessarily belongs to every composite thing

pairs.ja: ולא תדרכהא חאסה מן אלחואס אלג'סמאניה
pairs.en: No one of the bodily senses grasps it
rather the intellect grasps it
through the mediation of the moving thing
which the senses do grasp
And were it not for motion
the being of nothing would be completed

קיט.en: the coming-to-be of any of the existent things would not have been completed, nor their corruption.

pairs.en: the existent things
nor their corruption

קיט.ja: וקאל בעץ' אלפלאספה רוח אלטבאיע אלחרכה.
קיט.en: Some of the philosophers have said: the spirit of natures is motion.

pairs.en: Some of the philosophers have said
the spirit of natures
is motion

קיט.ja: פאד'א עקלת סר אלחרכה ופהמת מעני חקיקתהא ורוחאניתהא, ועלמת אנהא מן לטאיף אלחכמה אלאלאהיה, ומיזת קוהֵ ענאיהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי באלכ'לק, תחקקת ענד ד'לך אן חרכאתד כלהא מזמומה באראדהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי ותדבירה ומשיתה דקיקהא וג'לילהא כ'פייהא וט'אהרהא, אלא מא פווץ' אמרה אליך מן אכ'תיאר אלטאעה ואלמעציה.
קיט.en: When you have understood the secret of motion, and grasped the concept of its true reality and its spirituality, and known that it is among the subtleties of divine wisdom; and discriminated the strength of the Creator's providence (exalted be He) over creation — then you will become verified-of-the-reality that all your motions are bridled by the will of the Creator (exalted be He), and His management, and His wish — the small and the great of them, the hidden and the manifest — save what He has entrusted to you of the choice of obedience or transgression.

pairs.en: When you have understood the secret of motion
and grasped the concept of its true reality and its spirituality

pairs.ja: ועלמת אנהא מן לטאיף אלחכמה אלאלאהיה
pairs.en: and known that it is among the subtleties of divine wisdom

pairs.ja: ומיזת קוהֵ ענאיהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי באלכ'לק
pairs.en: and discriminated the strength of the Creator's providence (exalted be He) over creation
then you will become verified-of-the-reality
that all your motions are bridled
by the will of the Creator (exalted be He)
and His management, and His wish
the small and the great of them, the hidden and the manifest
save what He has entrusted to you
of the choice of obedience or transgression

קיט.ja: פאד'א תחקקת ד'לך תפקד נפסך ענד כל חרכה תתחרך להא, ואד'כר זמאם אללה ג'ל ועז עליך פיהא, ולאזם אלחיא מנה, ואלרקבה לה, ואלאסתסלאם לחכמה, וארץ' בקצ'איה תצל אלי רצ'איה, ותחסן עאקבהֵ אמורך, כקול אלולי ע"ס והבוטח בה' חסד יסובבנו.
קיט.en: When you have verified-of-the-reality of this, examine your soul at every motion you move with, and remember God's bridle (mighty and exalted) upon you in it; and bind yourself to shame before Him, and to watchful awareness of Him, and to submission to His judgment — be satisfied with His decree, and you shall arrive at His satisfaction, and the outcome of your matters shall be made beautiful — as the Friend (peace be upon him) said: "And the one who trusts in the Lord — kindness shall encompass him" (Psalms 32:10).

pairs.en: When you have verified-of-the-reality of this
examine your soul
at every motion you move with

pairs.ja: ואד'כר זמאם אללה ג'ל ועז עליך פיהא
pairs.en: and remember God's bridle (mighty and exalted) upon you in it
and bind yourself to shame before Him
and to watchful awareness of Him
and to submission to His judgment
be satisfied with His decree
and you shall arrive at His satisfaction
and the outcome of your matters shall be made beautiful
as the Friend (peace be upon him) said
"And the one who trusts in the Lord — kindness shall encompass him"

קיט.ja: וממא ינבגי לך אן תעתבר בה מן אמור אלעאלם, אלתעאהד לעואקב אלאמור אלתי תעסר מנא ותיסר לנא, סתרי פיהא עג'בא עג'יבא, פאן כת'ירא ממא יקע בכרה מנא נחמד עאקבהֵ אמרה, ובאלצ'ד.
קיט.en: And among the matters of the world by which it is fitting for you to take a lesson is to attend to the outcomes of affairs that turn difficult for us and that turn easy for us — in this you shall see a most wondrous wonder, for many a thing that befalls us with our reluctance, we come to praise the outcome of its matter, and the reverse as well.

pairs.ja: וממא ינבגי לך אן תעתבר בה
pairs.en: And among the matters of the world by which it is fitting for you to take a lesson
of the world
is to attend to the outcomes of affairs
that turn difficult for us and that turn easy for us
in this you shall see a most wondrous wonder

pairs.ja: פאן כת'ירא ממא יקע בכרה מנא
pairs.en: for many a thing that befalls us with our reluctance
we come to praise the outcome of its matter
and the reverse as well

קיט.ja: וקד קיל אן קומא מן אלמסאפרין באתוא עלי אצל ג'דאר, פאתי כלב ובאל עלי אחדהם, וקאם עלי קדמיה ליגתסל מן אלבול, פלמא אבעד ען אצחאבה אנהד אלג'דאר עליהם פמאתוא וכ'לץ הו.
קיט.en: And it has been told that a band of travelers spent the night at the foot of a wall, and a dog came and urinated upon one of them, so he rose to his feet to wash himself of the urine; and when he had drawn away from his companions, the wall collapsed upon them and they died, while he was saved.

pairs.en: And it has been told
that a band of travelers
spent the night at the foot of a wall
and a dog came and urinated upon one of them
so he rose to his feet
to wash himself of the urine
and when he had drawn away from his companions
the wall collapsed upon them
and they died, while he was saved

קיט.ja: ואיצ'א אן אנסאנא כאן מאשיא פי קאפלה, פאחתאג' אלי אלאנג'א, פתבאעד ענהא ויקצ'י חאג'תה, פהו בכ'לל אלטריק אד' תם מן קצ'א חאג'תה אסתרקד בגיר קצד מנה, פאנתבה
קיט.en: And likewise, a man was walking in a caravan, and he had need to relieve himself, so he drew away from it to attend to his need; and while he was in a gap of the road, when he had finished relieving himself, he dozed off without intending it, then awoke

pairs.en: And likewise

pairs.ja: אן אנסאנא כאן מאשיא פי קאפלה
pairs.en: a man was walking in a caravan
and he had need to relieve himself
so he drew away from it
to attend to his need
and while he was in a gap of the road
when he had finished relieving himself
he dozed off without intending it
then awoke

קכ.ja: בעד סאעה פבהת ונדם עלי רקאדה, פמשי תלקא אלקאפלה טמעא אן ילחקהא,
קכ.en: He awoke after an hour, was dismayed, and regretted his sleep; he set out toward the caravan, hoping to catch up with it.

pairs.en: after an hour
was dismayed
and regretted his sleep
he set out toward the caravan
hoping to catch up with it

קכ.ja: פלחק בהא פי אלמוצ'ע אלד'י פארקהא פיה ואד'א בהא מקתולה, קד כ'רג'ת עליהא אללצוץ וסלבתהא וקתלתהא,
קכ.en: He caught up with it at the place where he had parted from it — and behold, it had been slaughtered: bandits had fallen upon it, and despoiled it, and killed them.

pairs.en: He caught up with it
at the place where he had parted from it
and behold, it had been slaughtered
bandits had fallen upon it
and despoiled it
and killed them

קכ.ja: וכת'יר מא יערץ' מן הד'א וצ'דה.
קכ.en: Many things like this and the opposite occur.

pairs.en: Many things
like this and the opposite

קכ.ja: ומן אעט'ם מא ינבגי לך אלאעתבאר בה, פהו עמום אלארזאק לחיואן אלארץ' ונבאתהא, מת'ל אלאמטאר ענד אלחאג'ה אליהא, ונזולהא פי אוקאתהא,
קכ.en: And among the greatest of what is fitting that you reflect upon is the universality of sustenance for the animal of the earth and its plants — like the rains in their time of need and their falling in their seasons —

pairs.ja: ומן אעט'ם מא ינבגי לך אלאעתבאר בה
pairs.en: And among the greatest of what is fitting that you reflect upon
is the universality of sustenance
for the animal of the earth and its plants
like the rains in their time of need
and their falling in their seasons

קכ.ja: כקול אלכתאב היש בהבלי הגוים מגשימים ואם השמים יתנו רביבים הלא אתה הוא ה' אלהינו ונקוה לך,
קכ.en: as the Book says: "Are there any among the vanities of the gentiles that can cause rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are You not He, O Lord our God? We hope in You" (Jeremiah 14:22).

pairs.en: as the Book says
Are there any among the vanities of the gentiles that can cause rain
Or can the heavens give showers
Are You not He, O Lord our God
We hope in You

קכ.ja: וקאל ולא אמרו בלבבם נירא נא את ה' אלהינו הנותן גשם יורה ומלקוש בעתו שבועות חקות קציר ישמר לנו.
קכ.en: And He said: "They did not say in their hearts: Let us now fear the Lord our God, who gives the rain — the former rain and the latter rain — in its season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of the harvest" (Jeremiah 5:24).

pairs.en: And He said
They did not say in their hearts
Let us now fear the Lord our God
who gives the rain — the former rain and the latter rain — in its season
who keeps for us the appointed weeks of the harvest

קכ.ja: ותג'ד אלכתאב יעט'ם אמרהא כת'ירא פי קולה עושה גדולות ואין חקר ונפלאות עד אין מספר, הנותן מטר על פני ארץ ושולח מים על פני חוצות, לשום שפלים למרום וקודרים שגבו ישע.
קכ.en: The Book magnifies the matter of it greatly in its saying: "Who does great things beyond searching out, wonders without number, who gives rain upon the face of the earth, and sends water upon the face of the fields, to set up on high those that are low, and those that mourn for safety are exalted" (Job 5:9-11).

pairs.en: The Book
magnifies the matter of it greatly
in its saying
Who does great things beyond searching out
wonders without number
who gives rain upon the face of the earth
and sends water upon the face of the fields
to set up on high those that are low
and those that mourn for safety are exalted

קכ.ja: ומן אלעג'ב מן אסבאב אלאקואת מן אלחבוב, אן אלחבה אלואחדה תת'מר אלף חבה ואכת'ר מן ד'לך אד'א סלמת מן אלאפאת.
קכ.en: And among the wonders, of the causes of foods from the grains, is that a single grain bears a thousand grains and more, if it is preserved from injuries.

pairs.en: And among the wonders
of the causes of foods from the grains

pairs.ja: אן אלחבה אלואחדה תת'מר אלף חבה
pairs.en: is that a single grain bears a thousand grains
and more
if it is preserved from injuries

קכ.ja: וקד קיל אן יוג'ד פי אלחבה אלואחדה מן אלקמח ת'לאת' מאיהֵ סנבלה, ופי כל סנבלה ניף עלי עשרין חבה מן אלקמח פי בעץ' אלמואצ'ע.
קכ.en: It has been said that there is found in a single grain of wheat three hundred ears, and in every ear more than twenty grains of wheat - in some places.

pairs.en: It has been said

pairs.ja: אן יוג'ד פי אלחבה אלואחדה מן אלקמח
pairs.en: that there is found in a single grain of wheat
three hundred ears
and in every ear

pairs.ja: ניף עלי עשרין חבה מן אלקמח
pairs.en: more than twenty grains of wheat
in some places

קכ.ja: ונג'ד אלת'מאר אלעט'אם אלד'י יכון אצלהא חבה ואחדה ונבאתהא ואחד עלי אלקיאס אלד'י ד'כרת מן אלתצ'עיף.
קכ.en: We find the great fruits whose root is a single seed and whose growth is from one - according to the analogy of multiplication that I have mentioned.

pairs.en: We find the great fruits
whose root is a single seed
and whose growth is from one
according to the analogy
of multiplication

קכ.ja: פסבחאן אלחכים אלראזק אלמסבב לכון אלאשיא אלג'סימה מן אלטף אלאסבאב ואצ'עפהא, כקול אלכתאב ולו נתכנו עלילות.
קכ.en: Glory be to the Wise One, the Sustainer, who appoints great things to come about from the subtlest of causes and the weakest of them - as the Book says: "And actions are weighed" (1 Samuel 2:3).

pairs.en: Glory be to the Wise One, the Sustainer
who appoints great things to come about
from the subtlest of causes and the weakest of them
as the Book says
And actions are weighed

קכ.ja: ואמא כ'צוציאת אלארזאק לאשכ'אץ אנואע אלחיואן פאכת'ר מן אן יחוט בה וצפנא,
קכ.en: As for the particularities of sustenance for the individuals of the kinds of animals, that is more than our description can encompass,

pairs.en: As for the particularities of sustenance
for the individuals of the kinds of animals

pairs.ja: פאכת'ר מן אן יחוט בה וצפנא
pairs.en: that is more than our description can encompass

קכ.ja: ואלחאד'ק אד'א תאמל ותפהם אסבאבהא מייז ען חכמהֵ תדביר אלכ'אלק פיהא,
קכ.en: and the discerning one, when he reflects and grasps its causes, perceives therein the wisdom of the Creator's governance,

pairs.en: and the discerning one
when he reflects and grasps its causes
perceives
therein the wisdom of the Creator's governance

קכ.ja: וענהא יקול אלולי כלם אליך ישברון לתת אכלם בעתו תתן להם ילקוטון תפתח ידך
קכ.en: and concerning it the saint says: "They all wait upon You, to give them their food in its season; You give to them, they gather it; You open Your hand" (Psalms 145:15-16).

pairs.en: and concerning it the saint says
They all wait upon You
to give them their food in its season
You give to them, they gather it
You open Your hand
they are satisfied with good

קכא.ja: וקאל פותח את ידיך ומשביע לכל חי רצון.
קכא.en: And He said: "You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing's desire" (Psalms 145:16).

pairs.en: And He said
You open Your hand
and satisfy every living thing's desire

קכא.ja: וסאזיד הד'א אלמעני ביאנא פי באב אלתוכל עלי אללה אן שא אללה תעאלי.
קכא.en: I shall enlarge upon this matter in the Gate of Reliance on God, God (exalted be He) willing.

pairs.en: I shall enlarge
upon this matter
in the Gate of Reliance on God
God (exalted be He) willing

קכא.ja: ומן אג'ל נעמה אנעם אללה בהא עלי אלאנסאן ואקואהא דלאלה עליה, פאלשריעה אלמוחי בהא אלי אלרסול ע"ס, וט'הור אלאיאת עלי ידיה, וכ'רק אלעאדאת, ותגייר אלטבאיע, ואט'האר אלמעג'זאת לתצדיק אלכ'אלק ואלת'קה באלרסול,
קכא.en: And among the greatest of blessings God has bestowed upon the human, and the strongest in indication of Him, is the Law revealed to the Messenger (peace be upon him); and the appearing of the signs by his hand, and the breaking-of-the-ordinary, and the altering of natures, and the showing-forth of miracles — for the verifying of the Creator and the certainty of His messenger —

pairs.en: And among the greatest of blessings
God has bestowed upon the human
and the strongest in indication of Him
is the Law revealed to the Messenger
(peace be upon him)
and the appearing of the signs by his hand
and the breaking-of-the-ordinary
and the altering of natures
and the showing-forth of miracles
for the verifying of the Creator
and the certainty of His messenger

קכא.ja: כקולה וירא ישראל את היד הגדולה אשר עשה ה' במצרים וייראו העם את ה' ויאמינו בה' ובמשה עבדו,
קכא.en: as it is said: "And Israel saw the great hand which the Lord did against the Egyptians, and the people feared the Lord, and they believed in the Lord and in Moses His servant" (Exodus 14:31);

pairs.en: as it is said
And Israel saw the great hand
which the Lord did against the Egyptians
and the people feared the Lord
and they believed in the Lord and in Moses His servant

קכא.ja: וקאל אתה הראית לדעת כי ה' הוא האלהים אין עוד מלבדו,
קכא.en: and He said: "You have been shown to know that the Lord is God, there is none other besides Him" (Deuteronomy 4:35);

pairs.en: and He said
You have been shown to know
that the Lord is God
there is none other besides Him

קכא.ja: וקאל מן השמים השמיעך את קולו ליסרך ועל הארץ הראך את אשו הגדולה ודבריו שמעת מתוך האש.
קכא.en: and He said: "Out of the heavens He made you hear His voice, that He might discipline you; and upon the earth He made you see His great fire, and you heard His words out of the midst of the fire" (Deuteronomy 4:36).

pairs.en: and He said
Out of the heavens He made you hear His voice
that He might discipline you

pairs.ja: ועל הארץ הראך את אשו הגדולה
pairs.en: and upon the earth He made you see His great fire
and you heard His words out of the midst of the fire

קכא.ja: פאן טלב טאלב פי עהדנא מא ישבה תלך אלאת'אר פלינט'ר בעין אלאנצאף מן חאלנא בין אלאמם מנד' זמאן אלגלות ואנתט'אם אמורנא בינהם עלי כ'לאפנא להם פי אלסר ואלג'הר ועלמהם בד'לך מנא,
קכא.en: If, in our time, anyone seeks the like of these traces — let him look with the eye of fairness at our state among the nations from the time of the exile, the ordering of our matters among them, despite our being against them in secret and openly, and their knowledge of this from us;

pairs.en: If, in our time, anyone seeks
in our time
the like of these traces
let him look with the eye of fairness
at our state among the nations
from the time of the exile
the ordering of our matters among them

pairs.ja: עלי כ'לאפנא להם פי אלסר ואלג'הר
pairs.en: despite our being against them in secret and openly
and their knowledge of this from us

קכא.ja: פירי אן חאלנא רבמא קארבת חאלהם פי אלאקואת ואלארזאק, ורבמא כאנת חאלנא אפצ'ל מן חאלהם פי אוקאת אלחרב ואלפתן,
קכא.en: he will see that our state, perhaps, has equaled their state in foods and sustenance, and perhaps our state has been better than theirs in times of war and dissension —

pairs.en: he will see
that our state
perhaps, has equaled their state
in foods and sustenance

pairs.ja: ורבמא כאנת חאלנא אפצ'ל מן חאלהם
pairs.en: and perhaps our state has been better than theirs
in times of war and dissension

קכא.ja: פתרי רעיתהא וסואד באדיתהא אשקי כת'ירא מן אוסאטנא וסאקטנא,
קכא.en: so that you see [the nations'] peasantry and the lowly populace of their countryside more miserable by far than our middle ones and our lowliest.

pairs.en: so that you see [the nations'] peasantry
and the lowly populace of their countryside
more miserable by far
than our middle ones and our lowliest

קכא.ja: עלי מא צ'מן לנא אלכ'אלק תעאלי ואף גם זאת בהיותם בארץ אויביהם לא מאסתים ולא געלתים,
קכא.en: This is on the strength of the assurance the Creator (exalted be He) has given us: "And yet, even when they are in the land of their enemies, I shall not despise them, nor shall I abhor them" (Leviticus 26:44);

pairs.en: This is on the strength of the assurance
the Creator (exalted be He) has given us
And yet, even
when they are in the land of their enemies
I shall not despise them, nor shall I abhor them

קכא.ja: וקאל עזרא כי עבדים אנחנו ובעבדותינו לא עזבנו אלהינו,
קכא.en: and Ezra said: "Though we are slaves, yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery" (Ezra 9:9);

pairs.en: and Ezra said
Though we are slaves
yet our God has not forsaken us in our slavery

קכא.ja: וקאל אלולי לולי ה' שהיה לנו יאמר נא ישראל בקום עלינו אדם, וסאיר אלמזמור.
קכא.en: and the Friend said: "If it had not been the Lord who was for us, let Israel now say — when men rose up against us…" (Psalms 124:1–2), and the rest of the Psalm.

pairs.en: and the Friend said
If it had not been the Lord who was for us
let Israel now say
when men rose up against us
and the rest of the Psalm

קכא.ja: וסאתסע פי באב אלתזאם טאעהֵ אללה מן ד'כר פצ'ל נעמה עלינא פי שריעתה אלתי שרעהא עלינא מא פיה כפאיה אן שא אללה.
קכא.en: I shall expand in the Gate of Binding-Oneself-to-Obedience-to-God on the mention of the bounty of His blessing upon us in the Law He laid down for us — what shall suffice, God willing.

pairs.en: I shall expand
in the Gate of Binding-Oneself-to-Obedience-to-God
on the mention of the bounty of His blessing upon us
in the Law He laid down for us
what shall suffice
God willing

קכא.ja: וממא יג'ב אן יכ'טר עלי באלך ותעתבר בה, פהו אג'תמאע כלמהֵ ג'מהור אלנאס ותאליף
קכא.en: And among what is fitting should occur to your mind — and you should reflect on it — is the gathering of the word of the multitude of the people and the binding-together

pairs.en: And among what is fitting
should occur to your mind
and you should reflect on it
is the gathering of the word
of the multitude of the people
and the binding-together

קכב.ja: קלובהם עלי שדהֵ תבאין אכ'לאקהם, עלי תקדים רג'ל מנהם עליהם,
קכב.en: their hearts, despite the great divergence of their characters, upon the setting of one man among them over them,

pairs.en: their hearts
despite the great divergence of their characters
upon the setting of one man among them over them

קכב.ja: ילתזמון טאעתה ויקפון ענד אמרה ונהיה, ויהאבון קדרה,
קכב.en: they cleave to his obedience and halt at his command and his prohibition, and they revere his power,

pairs.en: they cleave to his obedience
and halt at his command and his prohibition
and they revere his power

קכב.ja: פיחפט'הם וישפק עליהם ויעדל בינהם, ויחמלהם עלי מא פיה צלאח ג'מיעהם,
קכב.en: so he preserves them and has compassion upon them and deals justly among them, and brings them upon that in which lies the welfare of them all,

pairs.en: so he preserves them
and has compassion upon them
and deals justly among them
and brings them
upon that in which lies the welfare of them all

קכב.ja: פלא תנהמל אמורהם ולא יתמכן אלעדו מנהם.
קכב.en: so that their affairs are not neglected and the enemy gains no mastery over them.

pairs.en: so that their affairs are not neglected
and the enemy gains no mastery over them

קכב.ja: ולו נט'ר כל ואחד מן אלנאס לנפסה פי אלדפע ענה לם יתפקוא עלי בניאן חצן ולא סור וצ'אעת אחואלהם.
קכב.en: And were each one of the people to look to himself in repelling harm from himself, they would not agree upon the building of a fortress nor a wall, and their conditions would be ruined.

pairs.ja: ולו נט'ר כל ואחד מן אלנאס
pairs.en: And were each one of the people to look
to himself
in repelling harm from himself
they would not agree
upon the building of a fortress nor a wall
and their conditions would be ruined

קכב.ja: ומע ד'לך, פאן אלולי עלי אלנאס מע תדבירה להם פאנה יחפט' רסום אלשראיע ויחמל אלנאס עלי אלסנן אלעאדלה ואת'אר אלג'מיל אלפאצ'לה,
קכב.en: Together with this, the friend over the people — with his management of them — preserves the impressions of the Laws, and brings the people upon the just customs and the traces of the excellent beauty:

pairs.en: Together with this
the friend over the people
with his management of them
preserves the impressions of the Laws
and brings the people upon the just customs
and the traces of the excellent beauty

קכב.ja: פהו כ'אדם אלשריעה וחאפט' ללסיאסה אלעאדלה, ובהמא ת'באת אמרה ודואם מלכה,
קכב.en: he is the servant of the Law and the keeper of just polity — by these two his matter is stable and his kingship endures,

pairs.en: he is the servant of the Law
and the keeper of just polity
by these two
his matter is stable
and his kingship endures

קכב.en: as it is said: "Kindness and truth preserve the king" (Proverbs 20:28);

pairs.en: as it is said
"Kindness and truth preserve the king"

קכב.ja: וקאל אואילנא הוי מתפלל בשלומה של מלכות שאלמלא מוראה איש את רעהו חיים בלעו.
קכב.en: and our early ones said: "Pray for the welfare of the kingdom, for were it not for the fear of it, every man would swallow his fellow alive" (m. Avot 3:2).

pairs.en: and our early ones said
"Pray for the welfare of the kingdom
for were it not for the fear of it
every man would swallow his fellow alive"

קכב.ja: וממא יג'ב לך יא אכ'י אן תעתבר פיה ותפהם את'אר אלחכמה אלעאליה ואלענאיה אלבאלגה מנה,
קכב.en: And among what is fitting for you, O my brother, that you reflect upon and comprehend of the traces of high wisdom and consummate providence:

pairs.en: And among what is fitting for you
O my brother
that you reflect upon
and comprehend
of the traces of high wisdom
and consummate providence

קכב.ja: פהו אצטלאח אלנאס עלי אלשרא ואלביע באלפצ'ה ואלד'הב, וסעיהם פי אלאסתכת'אר מנהמא, לטפא מן אללה להם ליכון בהמא קואם חאלהם,
קכב.en: people's convention to buy and sell with silver and gold, and their striving to accumulate them — a subtle gift of God to them, so that by these two the maintenance of their state may stand.

pairs.en: people's convention
to buy and sell
with silver and gold
and their striving to accumulate them
a subtle gift of God to them
so that by these two the maintenance of their state may stand

קכב.ja: ואן לם תנקץ' בהמא חאג'ה פי אנפסהמא, פאן אלד'י ילחקה אלם אלג'וע ואלעטש לעדם אלגד'א ואלמא לא ינפעה כת'ירהא, ולא יגני ענה שיא.
קכב.en: Yet need is not satisfied by these in themselves: for he who is overtaken by the pain of hunger and thirst, lacking food and water — the abundance of these does not benefit him, nothing of them avails him.

קכג.en: The stronger the need for a thing is, the more readily-found and existing it is; the more endurance and patience are possible for a thing, the harder it is to find and the rarer in being.

קכג.ja: ומת'אל ד'לך, אן אלהוא אלמסתנשק למא לם ימכן אלצבר דונה סאעה פמא פוקהא בתה, אוג'דה אלכ'אלק עז וג'ל פי אלעאלם ומכן מנה תמכינא לא יתעד'ר עלי אחד חית' מא כאן פי כל זמאן וכל מכאן.
קכג.en: The example of this: since one cannot endure without the air one breathes — even for an hour or more, in any way — the Creator (mighty and exalted) brought it into existence in the world and made it readily-available, so that it is not impossible for anyone, wherever he be, at any time and in any place.

קכג.en: It is available to some of the animals more than to others, while the air is equal in being-found and in apprehension by all of them, always in one state.

קכג.en: Then, since food too is needed — except that endurance without it, and substitution for it, are more possible than for air or water by far — its apprehension is more difficult and its being-found is rarer than water by far. Yet, in spite of this, it is abundantly existent, not absolutely impossible to people.

קכד.ja: ואמא אלאחג'אר אלעזיזה ואלפצ'ה ואלד'הב וסאיר אלמעדניאת, למא כאנת אקל חאג'ה פי ד'אתהא ואבעד מנפעה אלא באלאצטלאח עליהא, לם יוג'ד מנהא ענד ג'מהור אלנאס מא יוג'ד מן אלטעאם ענד ואחד מנהם, וד'לך ללעלה אלתי וצפתהא מן אלאסתגנא ענהא.
קכד.en: As for precious stones, silver, gold, and the rest of the minerals — since they are of less need in themselves and more remote in benefit except by convention regarding them, there is not found of them among the generality of people what is found of food with a single one of them; and that is for the reason I described, of the dispensability of them.

קכד.en: So glory be to the Creator, the Wise, the Gracious to His servants, the Merciful upon them, intense in care for their welfare — there is no god besides Him — as in His saying to Jonah: "You took pity on the gourd, for which you did not labor and which you did not raise, and shall I not have pity on Nineveh, the great city?" (Jonah 4:10-11). And the Friend, peace be upon him, said: "The Lord is good to all, and His mercies are over all His works" (Psalms 145:9).

קכד.ja: ומנהא אלעג'ב בנעם אללה עז וג'ל, פיט'ן אלג'אהל אלגבי אנה אהל להא ולמא הו אכת'ר מנהא, פליס יעתבר בנעם אללה ולא ילזם נפסה ענהא חמדא ושכרא ללכ'אלק, ופי מת'לה קאל אלחכים תועבת ה' כל גבה לב.
קכד.en: And among them is wonderment at the blessings of God (mighty and exalted) — so that the ignorant, the dim-witted, supposes that he is worthy of them and of what is greater than they; he does not reflect on the blessings of God, nor bind upon himself thanks and praise to the Creator for them. Concerning his like the Wise One said: "Every one proud of heart is an abomination to the Lord" (Proverbs 16:5).

קכד.ja: ואמא תואבע אלאעתבאר, פמנהא תחציל אלאנסאן נעם אללה עליה ואלתזאם אלטאעה לה ענהא, ומנהא תרדיד את'אר חכמהֵ אלכ'אלק תעאלי פי נפסה דאימא, ואן לא יכ'לו מן אלתפכר פיהא ואלבחת' ענהא פי כל מא ירד עליה מן אלמחסוסאת ואלמעקולאת, פלא יזאל ירי את'רא ג'דידא פי כל יום, כמא קאל אלולי יום ליום יביע אומר.
קכד.en: As for the concomitants of reflection: of these is the human's collecting of God's blessings upon him, and his binding-himself-to-obedience on account of them; and of these is the human's perpetually turning over the traces of the Creator's wisdom (exalted be He) in his own soul — so that he is never empty of cogitation upon them and inquiry into them in everything that comes upon him among sensible and intelligible objects. He never ceases to see a new trace each day, as the Friend said: "Day unto day pours forth speech" (Psalms 19:3).

pairs.en: The king's messenger used to come back and forth to him
with all that he needed
of lamp and food and drink and clothing
and he made known to him that he is the king's servant
and that the dungeon
with all it contains
and with all the food the messenger brings to it
belongs to the king

קכה.ja: ת'ם אלזמה שכרה וחמדה, פקאל סבחאן צאחב הד'א אלמטבק אלד'י ציירני לה עבדא וכ'צני בג'מלהֵ נעמה וג'עלני המה ושגלה.
קכה.en: Then [the messenger] bound him to thanking and praising him; so he said: "Glory be to the master of this dungeon, who has made me his servant, and singled me out by the whole of his blessings, and made me his concern and his occupation."

pairs.en: Then [the messenger] bound him to thanking and praising him
so he said: "Glory be to the master of this dungeon
who has made me his servant
and singled me out by the whole of his blessings
and made me his concern and his occupation

קכה.ja: פקאל לה אלרסול, למא תקול הכד'א פאנך תכ'טי, אד' ליס הד'א אלמטבק פקט הו מלך אלמלך, פאן פי סעהֵ בלאדה מן אמת'אל הד'א אלמטבק מא לא יחצי כת'רה,
קכה.en: The messenger said to him: "Why do you speak so? You err! For this dungeon alone is not the kingdom of the king. In the breadth of his lands are dungeons like this — innumerable in multitude.

pairs.en: The messenger said to him
Why do you speak so
You err

pairs.ja: אד' ליס הד'א אלמטבק פקט הו מלך אלמלך
pairs.en: For this dungeon alone is not the kingdom of the king
In the breadth of his lands
are dungeons like this
innumerable in multitude

קכה.ja: וכד'לך ליסת בעבדה אנת וחדך, אד' עבידה אכת'ר מן אן יחוט בהם עדדא.
קכה.en: So too, you are not his servant alone — for his servants are more than can be numbered.

pairs.en: So too, you are not his servant alone
for his servants are more
than can be numbered

קכה.ja: וכד'לך מא באשרתה מן נעמתה ופצ'לה לא קדר לה מן נעמתה לגירך, וכד'לך שגלה באמרך לא קדר לה ענד שגלה בסואך.
קכה.en: And likewise: what you have experienced of his blessing and his bounty has no measure compared to his blessing upon others; and likewise his occupation with your matter has no measure compared to his occupation with what is besides you."

pairs.en: And likewise: what you have experienced
of his blessing and his bounty

pairs.ja: לא קדר לה מן נעמתה לגירך
pairs.en: has no measure compared to his blessing upon others
and likewise his occupation with your matter

pairs.ja: לא קדר לה ענד שגלה בסואך
pairs.en: has no measure compared to his occupation with what is besides you

קכה.ja: פקאל אלצבי אני לא עלם לי במא ד'כרת, אנמא פהמת מן אמר אלמלך חסב מא באשרתה מן מלכה ונעמתה פקט.
קכה.en: The child said: "I have no knowledge of what you have mentioned. I have understood the matter of the king only according to what I have experienced of his kingship and his blessing — only that."

pairs.en: The child said

pairs.ja: אני לא עלם לי במא ד'כרת
pairs.en: I have no knowledge of what you have mentioned
I have understood the matter of the king
only according to what I have experienced
of his kingship and his blessing

קכה.ja: פקאל לה אלרסול, קל סבחאן אלמלך אלעאלי אלד'י לא נהאיה למלכה, ולא גאיה
קכה.en: The messenger said to him: "Say: Glory be to the exalted King, whose kingdom has no end, and no limit—

pairs.en: The messenger said to him
Say: Glory be to the exalted King
whose kingdom has no end
and no limit

קכו.ja: לנעמתה ופצ'לה, ולא קדר לי פי עט'ים ג'נודה, ולא קימה לאמרי פי ג'לאלהֵ קדרתה סבחאנה.
קכו.en: no limit to His blessing and His bounty; no measure for me amid the magnitude of His armies, no value for my matter amid the majesty of His power, glorious is He.

pairs.en: no limit to His blessing and His bounty
no measure for me
amid the magnitude of His armies
no value for my matter
amid the majesty of His power
glorious is He

קכו.ja: פפהם אלצבי מן אמר אלמלך מא כאן יג'הל, ועט'ם קדרה פי נפסה, והאב אמרה, ואסתעט'ם נעמתה ומא ורדה מן קבלה לעט'ים שאנה, וצגר קימהֵ אלצבי פי מלכה, ואסתג'זל מואהבה.
קכו.en: The child understood, from the matter of the king, what he had been ignorant of; magnified his power in his own soul; held his command in awe; reckoned his blessing great, and what had come to him from the king's side, on account of the greatness of His estate; reckoned the value of the child within his kingdom slight, and his gifts abundant.

pairs.en: The child understood
from the matter of the king
what he had been ignorant of
magnified his power in his own soul
held his command in awe
reckoned his blessing great
and what had come to him from the king's side
on account of the greatness of His estate
reckoned the value of the child within his kingdom slight
and his gifts abundant

קכו.ja: ואנת יא אכ'י עלי מת'ל ד'לך פי אלפלך אלמחיט באלארץ', פאנא לא נעקל מא פי אקל בקעה מן אלארץ' פצ'לא ען ג'מלתהא, פכיף מא ורא אלפלך.
קכו.en: And you, O my brother, are the like of this regarding the sphere encompassing the earth — for we do not reason what is in the least patch of the earth, much less the whole of it, much less what is beyond the sphere.

pairs.en: And you, O my brother
are the like of this
regarding the sphere encompassing the earth
for we do not reason

pairs.ja: מא פי אקל בקעה מן אלארץ'
pairs.en: what is in the least patch of the earth
much less the whole of it
much less what is beyond the sphere

קכו.ja: פתפהם יא אכ'י הד'א אלמת'ל ואעתבר בה, ואפהם ען מעני אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז בחסב ד'לך ליעט'ם פי נפסך מא מנחך בה מן נעמה ופצ'אילה באחתפאלה בך מע ג'מלהֵ מכ'לוקאתה,
קכו.en: So comprehend, O my brother, this parable, and reflect by it; and grasp the concept of the Creator (mighty and exalted) according to this — so that there grow great within your soul that with which He has graced you of His blessings and bounties in His regard for you among the totality of His created things.

pairs.en: So comprehend, O my brother, this parable
and reflect by it

pairs.ja: ואפהם ען מעני אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז
pairs.en: and grasp the concept of the Creator (mighty and exalted)
according to this
so that there grow great within your soul

pairs.ja: מא מנחך בה מן נעמה ופצ'אילה
pairs.en: that with which He has graced you of His blessings and bounties
in His regard for you
among the totality of His created things

קכו.ja: ואנט'ר פי כתאבה ואמרה ונהיה בעין ג'לאלה, ואכ'טר עלי באלך עט'ים היבתך ואג'לאלך לכל מא ידרכך מן נעמהֵ מן הו פוקך מן אלנאס,
קכו.en: Look upon His Book, His command, and His prohibition with the eye of His majesty; and bring before your mind the magnitude of your dread and your reverence for whatever may come to you of a blessing from the one above you among people —

pairs.en: Look upon His Book, His command, and His prohibition
with the eye of His majesty
and bring before your mind
the magnitude of your dread and your reverence
for whatever may come to you of a blessing
from the one above you among people

קכו.ja: פאן עלי קדר פצ'ל מנזלתה מן מנזלתך וגנאה ענך יכון קדר ג'לאלהֵ נעמתה פי נפסך,
קכו.en: for according to the measure of the bounty of his rank above your rank, and his freedom-from-need-of-you, will be the measure of the majesty of his blessing in your soul.

pairs.en: for according to the measure
of the bounty of his rank above your rank
and his freedom-from-need-of-you
will be the measure of the majesty of his blessing
in your soul

קכו.ja: וכד'לך יכון לאמרה ונהיה בחסב ד'לך קדרא פי נפסך וסעיך ואג'תהאדך לה, פאפהם ותפהם תצב אן שא אללה.
קכו.en: So likewise it shall be, for His command and His prohibition, according to that — a measure in your soul, in your striving, and in your effort for Him. So comprehend and understand — you shall hit the mark, God willing.

pairs.en: So likewise it shall be
for His command and His prohibition
according to that
a measure in your soul
in your striving, and in your effort for Him
So comprehend and understand
you shall hit the mark
God willing

קכו.ja: ג'עלנא אללה ואיאך מן אלפאיזין בטאעתה, ואלממייזין לצ'רוב נעמתה ברחמתה וראפתה תעאלי.
קכו.en: May God set us and you among those granted success in His obedience, those who discriminate the various kinds of His blessing — by His mercy and His pity, exalted is He.

pairs.en: May God set us and you
among those granted success in His obedience
those who discriminate the various kinds of His blessing
by His mercy and His pity
exalted is He
